units.id: conversation:intro mission|With some trepidation, you give the shipyard owner your money and take your new ship for a test drive, piloting it out of the shipyard and onto a spare landing pad by the spaceport. Then you get out and look the ship over a bit more closely. You are busy polishing out a few rust spots with a piece of steel wool when an old man in grease-stained coveralls walks up.|23|0
units.english: With some trepidation, you give the shipyard owner your money and take your new ship for a test drive, piloting it out of the shipyard and onto a spare landing pad by the spaceport. Then you get out and look the ship over a bit more closely. You are busy polishing out a few rust spots with a piece of steel wool when an old man in grease-stained coveralls walks up.
units.italian: Con una certa apprensione dai i tuoi soldi al proprietario del cantiere e porti la tua nuova nave a fare un giro di prova, pilotandola fuori dal cantiere fino a una piazzola libera vicino allo spazioporto. Poi scendi e guardi la nave un po' più da vicino. Sei occupato a lucidare qualche macchia di ruggine con della paglietta d'acciaio quando si avvicina un vecchio con una tuta da lavoro macchiata di grasso.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Nothing quite like buying your very first starship," he says.|24|0
units.english: "Nothing quite like buying your very first starship," he says.
units.italian: "Non c'è niente come comprare la propria primissima nave stellare," dice.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Yeah, I'm still kind of in shock over how much money I spent."|26|0
units.english: "Yeah, I'm still kind of in shock over how much money I spent."
units.italian: "Sì, sono ancora un po' sotto shock per quanti soldi ho speso."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Well, I don't plan to get too attached to this one. I'll be flying something much nicer before long."|28|0
units.english: "Well, I don't plan to get too attached to this one. I'll be flying something much nicer before long."
units.italian: "Beh, non ho intenzione di affezionarmi a questa. Prima o poi volerò su qualcosa di molto meglio."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Beat it, old-timer, I've got more important things to do than chat with you."|30|0
units.english: "Beat it, old-timer, I've got more important things to do than chat with you."
units.italian: "Circa, vecchio, ho cose più importanti da fare che chiacchierare con te."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	He grins. "I know the feeling. It's a crime how much interest the banks charge to first-timers. It's been that way ever since when I first started out."|33|0
units.english: He grins. "I know the feeling. It's a crime how much interest the banks charge to first-timers. It's been that way ever since when I first started out."
units.italian: Sogghigna. "Conosco la sensazione. È un crimine quanto interesse chiedano le banche ai principianti. Va così da quando ho cominciato io."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	He smiles. "I'm sure you will. But there's something nice to having a ship you can pilot all by yourself. Believe me, once you have to start managing crew and paying salaries, or keeping track of a whole fleet, you'll miss these days when everything was simple."|36|0
units.english: He smiles. "I'm sure you will. But there's something nice to having a ship you can pilot all by yourself. Believe me, once you have to start managing crew and paying salaries, or keeping track of a whole fleet, you'll miss these days when everything was simple."
units.italian: Sorride. "Ne sono sicuro. Ma c'è qualcosa di bello in una nave che puoi pilotare tutto da solo. Credimi, quando dovrai gestire equipaggio e stipendi, o tenere dietro a un'intera flotta, rimpiangerai questi giorni in cui tutto era semplice."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|With some trepidation, you hand one of the salespeople your money, and they give you the passcode to your starship, along with the number of the docking bay your ship is being transported to. By the time you arrive, your <model> is already there, beckoning you aboard. You spend a minute admiring your ship until a man walks up to you. You recognize him as the old man who rode the train with you, and you wave.|40|0
units.english: With some trepidation, you hand one of the salespeople your money, and they give you the passcode to your starship, along with the number of the docking bay your ship is being transported to. By the time you arrive, your <model> is already there, beckoning you aboard. You spend a minute admiring your ship until a man walks up to you. You recognize him as the old man who rode the train with you, and you wave.
units.italian: Con una certa apprensione dai i tuoi soldi a uno dei venditori, e quello ti dà il codice di accesso alla tua nave stellare, insieme al numero della baia di attracco dove la stanno trasportando. Quando arrivi, la tua <model> è già lì e ti invita a salire. Passi un minuto ad ammirare la nave finché un uomo ti si avvicina. Lo riconosci: è il vecchio che ha viaggiato in treno con te, e lo saluti con la mano.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	He waves back, turns to look at your ship and says, "Nothing quite like buying your first starship, is there?"|41|0
units.english: He waves back, turns to look at your ship and says, "Nothing quite like buying your first starship, is there?"
units.italian: Ricambia il saluto, si volta a guardare la tua nave e dice: "Non c'è niente come comprare la propria prima nave stellare, vero?"

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Yeah, it's a real beauty."|43|0
units.english: "Yeah, it's a real beauty."
units.italian: "Sì, è davvero una bellezza."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"I'm hoping to fly a much better ship, honestly."|45|0
units.english: "I'm hoping to fly a much better ship, honestly."
units.italian: "Spero di volare su una nave molto migliore, a dire il vero."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Sorry, but I'd like to be left alone."|47|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'd like to be left alone."
units.italian: "Scusa, ma preferirei essere lasciato in pace."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	He grins. "And I'm sure you'll be modifying it for days on end to make it even more beautiful. God knows how long I spent tuning my own ships."|50|0
units.english: He grins. "And I'm sure you'll be modifying it for days on end to make it even more beautiful. God knows how long I spent tuning my own ships."
units.italian: Sogghigna. "E sono sicuro che la modificherai per giorni e giorni per renderla ancora più bella. Dio sa quanto tempo ho passato io a mettere a punto le mie navi."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|With some trepidation, you hand over your money and take your new ship for a test drive, piloting it out of the shipyard and onto a spare landing pad in the spaceport. You disembark and spend a minute admiring your ship until an old man in grease-stained coveralls walks up to you.|54|0
units.english: With some trepidation, you hand over your money and take your new ship for a test drive, piloting it out of the shipyard and onto a spare landing pad in the spaceport. You disembark and spend a minute admiring your ship until an old man in grease-stained coveralls walks up to you.
units.italian: Con una certa apprensione consegni i tuoi soldi e porti la nuova nave a fare un giro di prova, pilotandola fuori dal cantiere fino a una piazzola libera nello spazioporto. Scendi e passi un minuto ad ammirare la nave finché un vecchio con una tuta macchiata di grasso ti si avvicina.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Nothing quite like buying your first starship," he says.|55|0
units.english: "Nothing quite like buying your first starship," he says.
units.italian: "Non c'è niente come comprare la propria prima nave stellare," dice.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"I can't wait to explore the galaxy!"|57|0
units.english: "I can't wait to explore the galaxy!"
units.italian: "Non vedo l'ora di esplorare la galassia!"

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Just you wait; I'll be flying an entire fleet soon."|58|0
units.english: "Just you wait; I'll be flying an entire fleet soon."
units.italian: "Aspetta e vedrai; presto volerò con un'intera flotta."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"If I wanted to talk, I would have said something. Beat it."|60|0
units.english: "If I wanted to talk, I would have said something. Beat it."
units.italian: "Se volevo parlare, avrei detto qualcosa. Circa."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	He grins. "Well, don't be too hasty. The galaxy is a big and dangerous place, and not for the fainthearted. It'll be quite a while until you can make the universe your oyster. Took me decades."|62|0
units.english: He grins. "Well, don't be too hasty. The galaxy is a big and dangerous place, and not for the fainthearted. It'll be quite a while until you can make the universe your oyster. Took me decades."
units.italian: Sogghigna. "Beh, non essere troppo frettoloso. La galassia è un posto grande e pericoloso, e non è per i deboli di cuore. Passerà un bel po' prima che l'universo sia la tua ostrica. A me ci sono voluti decenni."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|With a strange sense of relief, you give the salesman your money and jump into your new ship. The flight from the shipyard to the landing bays has you navigate through tunnels with only centimeters of clearance in all directions. After setting your ship down and disembarking, an old man in grease-stained coveralls approaches you.|69|0
units.english: With a strange sense of relief, you give the salesman your money and jump into your new ship. The flight from the shipyard to the landing bays has you navigate through tunnels with only centimeters of clearance in all directions. After setting your ship down and disembarking, an old man in grease-stained coveralls approaches you.
units.italian: Con uno strano senso di sollievo dai i tuoi soldi al venditore e salti sulla tua nuova nave. Il volo dal cantiere alle baie di atterraggio ti fa passare per tunnel con appena centimetri di margine su ogni lato. Dopo aver posato la nave e essere sceso, un vecchio con una tuta macchiata di grasso ti si avvicina.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Nothing quite like buying your first starship," he says.|70|0
units.english: "Nothing quite like buying your first starship," he says.
units.italian: "Non c'è niente come comprare la propria prima nave stellare," dice.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"I'm just glad to be free from working for someone else."|72|0
units.english: "I'm just glad to be free from working for someone else."
units.italian: "Sono solo contento di essere libero dal lavorare per qualcun altro."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"And there's nothing quite like going six hundred thousand credits into debt."|73|0
units.english: "And there's nothing quite like going six hundred thousand credits into debt."
units.italian: "E non c'è niente come avere seicentomila crediti di debiti."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"If I wanted to talk with you, I'd have said something. Leave me alone."|75|0
units.english: "If I wanted to talk with you, I'd have said something. Leave me alone."
units.italian: "Se avessi voluto parlare con te, avrei detto qualcosa. Lasciami in pace."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	He grins. "Well, I wouldn't be so sure yet. Often, the quickest way to fame and fortune is to curry favor with the big players. I always preferred to work by myself, though."|77|0
units.english: He grins. "Well, I wouldn't be so sure yet. Often, the quickest way to fame and fortune is to curry favor with the big players. I always preferred to work by myself, though."
units.italian: Sogghigna. "Beh, non ne sarei così sicuro. Spesso la via più rapida alla fama e alla fortuna è ingraziarsi i pezzi grossi. Io però ho sempre preferito lavorare da solo."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|Sure enough, you find your new Jackal waiting in one of the port's landing bays. You start to examine the <ship>, and your worst fears are realized. Of the ship's outfits, the only one to pass any safety tests is the battery; you'll have to completely replace everything else. As you rip out broken components and throw them in the nearest dumpster, an old man in grease-stained coveralls approaches you.|81|0
units.english: Sure enough, you find your new Jackal waiting in one of the port's landing bays. You start to examine the <ship>, and your worst fears are realized. Of the ship's outfits, the only one to pass any safety tests is the battery; you'll have to completely replace everything else. As you rip out broken components and throw them in the nearest dumpster, an old man in grease-stained coveralls approaches you.
units.italian: Come previsto, trovi il tuo nuovo Jackal ad aspettarti in una delle baie dello scalo. Cominci a esaminare la <ship>, e le tue peggiori paure si avverano. Fra gli equipaggiamenti della nave, l'unico a superare qualsiasi test di sicurezza è la batteria; dovrai sostituire tutto il resto. Mentre strappi via i componenti rotti e li butti nel cassonetto più vicino, si avvicina un vecchio con una tuta macchiata di grasso.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Looks like you've landed yourself a real lemon, haven'tcha?" he says.|82|0
units.english: "Looks like you've landed yourself a real lemon, haven'tcha?" he says.
units.italian: "Pare che ti sia preso un bel catorcio, eh?" dice.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Yep."|84|0
units.english: "Yep."
units.italian: "Già."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Look, I'm having a really bad day today. Bother someone else."|85|0
units.english: "Look, I'm having a really bad day today. Bother someone else."
units.italian: "Senti, oggi è una giornata davvero storta. Vai a disturbare qualcun altro."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Well, there's no point crying over jettisoned cargo. Mind if I give you a hand?"|87|0
units.english: "Well, there's no point crying over jettisoned cargo. Mind if I give you a hand?"
units.italian: "Beh, non serve piangere sul carico buttato fuori. Ti do una mano?"

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	With the old man's help, you manage to clear out the Jackal before nightfall. "Haven't had to do this to a ship in a long time. Still, it's nice to have a blank slate when you're outfitting your fleet."|88|0
units.english: With the old man's help, you manage to clear out the Jackal before nightfall. "Haven't had to do this to a ship in a long time. Still, it's nice to have a blank slate when you're outfitting your fleet."
units.italian: Con l'aiuto del vecchio riesci a svuotare il Jackal prima che faccia notte. "È da molto che non dovevo fare una cosa del genere a una nave. Però è bello avere una base pulita quando si equipaggia la flotta."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"You're a captain?" you ask.|91|0
units.english: "You're a captain?" you ask.
units.italian: "Sei un capitano?" chiedi.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Was," he says. "Sold off my fleet a few days ago, and I already miss it. But it was time. Time for me to retire." His voice trails off, then his face lights up. "Say, any chance I could hitch a ride with you, maybe show you the ropes, give you some pointers? I could pay you, of course."|92|0
units.english: "Was," he says. "Sold off my fleet a few days ago, and I already miss it. But it was time. Time for me to retire." His voice trails off, then his face lights up. "Say, any chance I could hitch a ride with you, maybe show you the ropes, give you some pointers? I could pay you, of course."
units.italian: "Lo ero," dice. "Ho venduto la flotta pochi giorni fa, e già mi manca. Ma era ora. Ora di andare in pensione." La voce gli si perde, poi il viso gli si illumina. "Dimmi, ci sarebbe la possibilità di farmi fare un passaggio con te, magari mostrarti i trucchi del mestiere, darti qualche dritta? Naturalmente ti pagherei."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Sure, where are you trying to get to?"|94|0
units.english: "Sure, where are you trying to get to?"
units.italian: "Certo, dove devi andare?"

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"I'd rather figure things out on my own."|95|0
units.english: "I'd rather figure things out on my own."
units.italian: "Preferirei arrangiarmi da solo."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Well," he says, "I've got a spot reserved in a retirement home, but I don't mind taking a roundabout way to get there. For starters, how about you give me a lift to <planet>? It's just one jump away from here; I can mark it on your map."|97|0
units.english: "Well," he says, "I've got a spot reserved in a retirement home, but I don't mind taking a roundabout way to get there. For starters, how about you give me a lift to <planet>? It's just one jump away from here; I can mark it on your map."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "ho un posto prenotato in una casa di riposo, ma non mi dispiace fare la strada lunga per arrivarci. Per cominciare, che ne dici di portarmi su <planet>? È a un solo salto da qui; te lo segno sulla mappa."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Sounds good!"|99|0
units.english: "Sounds good!"
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene!"

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"How much will you pay me?"|101|0
units.english: "How much will you pay me?"
units.italian: "Quanto mi pagherai?"

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"That's kind of a rude question," he says, "but I'll pay you ten thousand credits. I guarantee you that's more than any captain ever gets for carrying one passenger for one day."|102|0
units.english: "That's kind of a rude question," he says, "but I'll pay you ten thousand credits. I guarantee you that's more than any captain ever gets for carrying one passenger for one day."
units.italian: "È una domanda un po' scortese," dice, "ma ti pagherò diecimila crediti. Ti garantisco che è più di quanto qualsiasi capitano abbia mai preso per portare un passeggero per un giorno."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"That's really generous. Thank you."|104|0
units.english: "That's really generous. Thank you."
units.italian: "È davvero generoso. Grazie."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"You're treating me like a charity case? No thanks, I'll earn my money legitimately."|106|0
units.english: "You're treating me like a charity case? No thanks, I'll earn my money legitimately."
units.italian: "Mi tratti come un caso di beneficenza? No grazie, i miei soldi me li guadagno onestamente."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Great," he says. "My name is James, by the way."|109|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "My name is James, by the way."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Mi chiamo James, comunque."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"<first> <last>," you say.|110|0
units.english: "<first> <last>," you say.
units.italian: "<first> <last>," dici.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"I'm looking forward to traveling with you, Captain <last>," says James.|111|0
units.english: "I'm looking forward to traveling with you, Captain <last>," says James.
units.italian: "Non vedo l'ora di viaggiare con te, Capitano <last>," dice James.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"<first> <last>?" he stops for a moment. "I've heard that name before. Reminds me of someone famous, I think," says James. "Anyways, I'm looking forward to traveling with you."|114|0
units.english: "<first> <last>?" he stops for a moment. "I've heard that name before. Reminds me of someone famous, I think," says James. "Anyways, I'm looking forward to traveling with you."
units.italian: "<first> <last>?" Si ferma un momento. "Ho già sentito questo nome. Mi ricorda qualcuno di famoso, credo," dice James. "Comunque, non vedo l'ora di viaggiare con te."

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	As you're helping him wheel his luggage aboard and showing him his bunk, he says, "Before we take off, you might head on over to the trading center and <trade>; we can sell those for a good profit on <planet>.|118|0
units.english: As you're helping him wheel his luggage aboard and showing him his bunk, he says, "Before we take off, you might head on over to the trading center and <trade>; we can sell those for a good profit on <planet>.
units.italian: Mentre lo aiuti a caricare i bagagli a bordo e gli mostri il suo posto letto, dice: "Prima di partire potresti passare dal centro commerciale e <trade>; possiamo venderli con un buon margine su <planet>.

units.id: conversation:intro mission|	"Also make sure to visit the local outfitter. <while>, every world with an outfitter will at least carry a map with information on the neighboring systems. Buying them can help if you're not quite sure where you're going."|119|0
units.english: "Also make sure to visit the local outfitter. <while>, every world with an outfitter will at least carry a map with information on the neighboring systems. Buying them can help if you're not quite sure where you're going."
units.italian: "E assicurati di passare dal fornitore locale. <while>, ogni mondo con un fornitore avrà almeno una mappa con le informazioni sui sistemi vicini. Comprarle aiuta se non sei del tutto sicuro di dove stai andando."

units.id: conversation:mission intro end|As you land on <planet>, James says, "Congrats on your first trip through hyperspace! I'm impressed that you didn't throw up; most folks do, the first time."|124|0
units.english: As you land on <planet>, James says, "Congrats on your first trip through hyperspace! I'm impressed that you didn't throw up; most folks do, the first time."
units.italian: Mentre atterri su <planet>, James dice: "Congratulazioni per il tuo primo viaggio nell'iperspazio! Sono impressionato che tu non abbia vomitato; la maggior parte lo fa, la prima volta."

units.id: conversation:mission intro end|	"Including you?" you ask.|125|0
units.english: "Including you?" you ask.
units.italian: "Anche tu?" chiedi.

units.id: conversation:mission intro end|	"Yeah, and then spent half an hour in orbit cleaning my cabin while hoping the passengers wouldn't come out of their bunk room and see the mess. Not my proudest moment. Anyway, here's your pay." He hands you <payment>.|126|0
units.english: "Yeah, and then spent half an hour in orbit cleaning my cabin while hoping the passengers wouldn't come out of their bunk room and see the mess. Not my proudest moment. Anyway, here's your pay." He hands you <payment>.
units.italian: "Sì, e poi ho passato mezz'ora in orbita a pulire la cabina sperando che i passeggeri non uscissero dalla loro cuccetta e vedessero il disastro. Non è stato il mio momento migliore. Comunque, ecco il tuo pagamento." Ti consegna <payment>.

units.id: conversation:mission intro end|	Then he adds, "If you're okay with giving me a lift for a while longer, sell off any of that cargo you bought and then meet me in the spaceport. I'll see if I can rustle up any interesting work for you to do."|127|0
units.english: Then he adds, "If you're okay with giving me a lift for a while longer, sell off any of that cargo you bought and then meet me in the spaceport. I'll see if I can rustle up any interesting work for you to do."
units.italian: Poi aggiunge: "Se ti va di darmi un passaggio ancora per un po', vendi tutto il carico che hai comprato e poi raggiungimi allo spazioporto. Vedrò di trovarti qualche lavoro interessante."

units.id: conversation:mission intro end|	(Click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)|129|0
units.english: (Click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)
units.italian: (Per continuare questa missione, premi il pulsante "Spazioporto".)

units.id: conversation:intro earth offer|The spaceport on <origin> is so big and crowded that it takes a long time to find James. The sheer number of people here is almost overwhelming. Homeless men wrapped in old army blankets beg money from well-dressed businessmen. Soldiers in Navy uniforms walk by in groups of ten or twenty, all marching in unison. Starship captains haggle with merchants over trade goods and jobs. Flashes of light come from various landing bays as welders make repairs.|134|0
units.english: The spaceport on <origin> is so big and crowded that it takes a long time to find James. The sheer number of people here is almost overwhelming. Homeless men wrapped in old army blankets beg money from well-dressed businessmen. Soldiers in Navy uniforms walk by in groups of ten or twenty, all marching in unison. Starship captains haggle with merchants over trade goods and jobs. Flashes of light come from various landing bays as welders make repairs.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di <origin> è così grande e affollato che ci vuole molto tempo per trovare James. La semplice quantità di gente qui è quasi opprimente. Uomini senza casa avvolti in vecchie coperte militari chiedono soldi a uomini d'affari ben vestiti. Soldati in uniforme della Marina passano in gruppi di dieci o venti, tutti in marcia compatta. Capitani di navi stellari contrattano con i mercanti su merci e lavori. Lampade di luce arrivano da varie baie mentre i saldatori fanno riparazioni.

units.id: conversation:intro earth offer|	When you find James, he's standing by a window, looking out at the city, watching the starships taking off and landing in a continuous stream. "This is it," he says, "where our race began. The world that all the tourists want to visit, and that no one wants to live on. Twenty billion people, more industry and exports than any other place in the galaxy. But underneath it all, poverty of a completely different sort from what <they've> got in the Dirt Belt."|135|0
units.english: When you find James, he's standing by a window, looking out at the city, watching the starships taking off and landing in a continuous stream. "This is it," he says, "where our race began. The world that all the tourists want to visit, and that no one wants to live on. Twenty billion people, more industry and exports than any other place in the galaxy. But underneath it all, poverty of a completely different sort from what <they've> got in the Dirt Belt."
units.italian: Quando trovi James, è in piedi vicino a una finestra, guarda la città e osserva le navi stellari che decollano e atterrano in un flusso continuo. "Ecco," dice, "dove è cominciata la nostra specie. Il mondo che tutti i turisti vogliono visitare e su cui nessuno vuole vivere. Venti miliardi di persone, più industria ed esportazioni di qualsiasi altro posto della galassia. Ma sotto tutto questo c'è una povertà di tipo completamente diverso da quella che si trova nella Dirt Belt."

units.id: conversation:intro earth offer|	After taking one last glance out the window, he says, "Anyway, we're nearing my destination. Are you willing to take me on one last trip? I need to get to <destination>, and of course I'll pay you quite well to take me there."|136|0
units.english: After taking one last glance out the window, he says, "Anyway, we're nearing my destination. Are you willing to take me on one last trip? I need to get to <destination>, and of course I'll pay you quite well to take me there."
units.italian: Dopo un ultimo sguardo fuori dalla finestra, dice: "Comunque, mi avvicino alla mia destinazione. Sei disposto a portarmi in un ultimo viaggio? Devo arrivare su <destination>, e naturalmente ti pagherò molto bene per portarmi là."

units.id: conversation:intro earth offer|	"Of course."|138|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: conversation:intro earth offer|	"Sorry, but I was planning on heading out in a different direction from here."|139|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I was planning on heading out in a different direction from here."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma pensavo di andare in una direzione diversa da qui."
