units.id: conversation:mining intro end|Once you've landed, you meet up with James and he asks you, "What did you think of mining?"|379|0
units.english: Once you've landed, you meet up with James and he asks you, "What did you think of mining?"
units.italian: Una volta atterrato, ti incontri con James e lui ti chiede: "Che cosa ne pensi dell'estrazione?"

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"I can't believe anyone would do that much work."|381|0
units.english: "I can't believe anyone would do that much work."
units.italian: "Non riesco a credere che qualcuno faccia tutto quel lavoro."

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"That was great!"|382|0
units.english: "That was great!"
units.italian: "È stato fantastico!"

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	James nods and says, "Chasing asteroids can be a challenge, but when you're starting off, mining can be a fast way to build cash for your next ship. It's also a great way to explore the galaxy. Jobs always follow the trade routes and settled areas. Mining makes it profitable to explore the nooks and crannies of the hyperlanes. If the place you end up landing has an economy, they'll buy the minerals in your hold. Mainly though, it's about how you like to spend your time. Some captains like managing a trading fleet while others like to strike out on their own.|383|0
units.english: James nods and says, "Chasing asteroids can be a challenge, but when you're starting off, mining can be a fast way to build cash for your next ship. It's also a great way to explore the galaxy. Jobs always follow the trade routes and settled areas. Mining makes it profitable to explore the nooks and crannies of the hyperlanes. If the place you end up landing has an economy, they'll buy the minerals in your hold. Mainly though, it's about how you like to spend your time. Some captains like managing a trading fleet while others like to strike out on their own.
units.italian: James annuisce e dice: "Dare la caccia agli asteroidi può essere impegnativo, ma quando inizi, l'estrazione può essere un modo rapido per mettere da parte contanti per la prossima nave. È anche un ottimo modo di esplorare la galassia. I lavori seguono sempre le rotte commerciali e le zone abitate. L'estrazione rende redditizio esplorare gli angoli e le fessure delle iperrotte. Se il posto in cui finisci per atterrare ha un'economia, compreranno i minerali nella tua stiva. Soprattutto, però, è questione di come ti piace passare il tempo. Ad alcuni capitani piace gestire una flotta commerciale, ad altri piace andare per conto proprio.

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"Mining can be complex compared to running jobs or trading commodities. I learned that first hand after pirates disabled my ship when I was starting out and I worked aboard a mining ship while it was being repaired. Now that was a while back so I might be a little rusty, but I could try at answering any other questions you might have about mining."|384|0
units.english: "Mining can be complex compared to running jobs or trading commodities. I learned that first hand after pirates disabled my ship when I was starting out and I worked aboard a mining ship while it was being repaired. Now that was a while back so I might be a little rusty, but I could try at answering any other questions you might have about mining."
units.italian: "L'estrazione può essere complessa rispetto a fare missioni o commerciare merci. L'ho imparato sulla mia pelle quando i pirati mi hanno disattivato la nave agli inizi e ho lavorato su una nave mineraria mentre la riparavano. È passato un po' di tempo, quindi potrei essere un po' arrugginito, ma posso provare a rispondere a qualsiasi altra domanda tu abbia sull'estrazione."

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"What equipment do I need to mine?"|388|0
units.english: "What equipment do I need to mine?"
units.italian: "Che attrezzatura mi serve per estrarre?"

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"How do you deal with pirates?"|391|0
units.english: "How do you deal with pirates?"
units.italian: "Come si fa con i pirati?"

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"How can I check the value of minerals?"|395|0
units.english: "How can I check the value of minerals?"
units.italian: "Come posso controllare il valore dei minerali?"

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"I think I have enough information."|399|0
units.english: "I think I have enough information."
units.italian: "Credo di avere abbastanza informazioni."

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"Well, you need a weapon that does hull damage," James says. "A Beam Laser will get the job done, but it will take a while. If you want to optimize your mining operations, however, you'll want a Mining Laser. Not only does it cut through asteroids faster, it's also more precise and preserves more minerals when the asteroid breaks apart. Some miners like to have a bit of combat flexibility by mining with Heavy Lasers, however.|404|0
units.english: "Well, you need a weapon that does hull damage," James says. "A Beam Laser will get the job done, but it will take a while. If you want to optimize your mining operations, however, you'll want a Mining Laser. Not only does it cut through asteroids faster, it's also more precise and preserves more minerals when the asteroid breaks apart. Some miners like to have a bit of combat flexibility by mining with Heavy Lasers, however.
units.italian: "Beh, ti serve un'arma che faccia danni allo scafo," dice James. "Un laser a fascio farà il lavoro, ma ci vorrà un po'. Se però vuoi ottimizzare l'estrazione, ti serve un laser minerario. Non solo taglia gli asteroidi più in fretta, ma è anche più preciso e conserva più minerali quando l'asteroide si rompe. Alcuni minatori preferiscono avere un po' di flessibilità in combattimento usando laser pesanti, però.

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"Aside from lasers, the most valuable tool is an asteroid scanner. They're expensive, but they connect into your navigation and targeting systems to point you towards minable asteroids. You can also set them to find the most valuable asteroids, which increases your profitability per run. After that, a tactical scanner will tell you how far away the asteroid is and show how much damage you're doing. An afterburner is good for chasing down fast moving asteroids or getting away from pirates without leaving the system. A ramscoop will let you refuel while mining, extend your exploration range, and allow you to be ready for a quick escape."|405|0
units.english: "Aside from lasers, the most valuable tool is an asteroid scanner. They're expensive, but they connect into your navigation and targeting systems to point you towards minable asteroids. You can also set them to find the most valuable asteroids, which increases your profitability per run. After that, a tactical scanner will tell you how far away the asteroid is and show how much damage you're doing. An afterburner is good for chasing down fast moving asteroids or getting away from pirates without leaving the system. A ramscoop will let you refuel while mining, extend your exploration range, and allow you to be ready for a quick escape."
units.italian: "A parte i laser, lo strumento più prezioso è uno scanner per asteroidi. Costano, ma si collegano ai sistemi di navigazione e puntamento per indirizzarti verso gli asteroidi estraibili. Puoi anche impostarli per trovare gli asteroidi più preziosi, il che aumenta la redditività di ogni uscita. Dopo, uno scanner tattico ti dice quanto è lontano l'asteroide e quanto danno stai facendo. Un postbruciatore è utile per raggiungere asteroidi veloci o per allontanarti dai pirati senza lasciare il sistema. Un ramscoop ti permette di rifornirti mentre estrai, estende il tuo raggio di esplorazione e ti tiene pronto a una fuga rapida."

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"I can't fit all that on my ship!"|407|0
units.english: "I can't fit all that on my ship!"
units.italian: "Non posso mettere tutto questo sulla mia nave!"

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"That all makes sense."|409|0
units.english: "That all makes sense."
units.italian: "Ha tutto senso."

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"Anything else you want to ask me?" says James.|410|0
units.english: "Anything else you want to ask me?" says James.
units.italian: "Vuoi chiedermi altro?" dice James.

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	James gives you a knowing smile as he answers, "Not in a factory build, you won't. But you'd be surprised how much space you can free up even in a <model> if you're willing to be flexible. Do you really need that much power? If you've got an outfitter on the planet where you're mining, do you need a hyperdrive, or even a shield generator? Maybe a cargo expansion would be of more use." He pauses briefly, perhaps considering what liability he's opened himself up for, then adds, "I'm not saying you should, of course, but you have options."|413|0
units.english: James gives you a knowing smile as he answers, "Not in a factory build, you won't. But you'd be surprised how much space you can free up even in a <model> if you're willing to be flexible. Do you really need that much power? If you've got an outfitter on the planet where you're mining, do you need a hyperdrive, or even a shield generator? Maybe a cargo expansion would be of more use." He pauses briefly, perhaps considering what liability he's opened himself up for, then adds, "I'm not saying you should, of course, but you have options."
units.italian: James ti fa un sorriso complice mentre risponde: "Con un allestimento di fabbrica, no di certo. Ma resteresti sorpreso da quanto spazio puoi liberare anche in una <model>, se sei disposto a essere flessibile. Ti serve davvero tutta quella potenza? Se hai un fornitore sul pianeta dove estrai, ti serve un iperguida, o persino un generatore di scudi? Forse un ampliamento della stiva sarebbe più utile." Fa una breve pausa, forse considerando a quale responsabilità si è esposto, poi aggiunge: "Non sto dicendo che dovresti farlo, naturalmente, ma hai delle opzioni."

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"You can always bribe them to leave you alone. If the minerals are good enough and you have enough cargo capacity, you'll still turn a profit. Or if you have a fast ship, you can just run away. Of course, with enough of a fleet you just fight them off." He shakes his head. "Most pirates would be richer and live longer if they just mined instead of extorting merchants and plundering ships."|419|0
units.english: "You can always bribe them to leave you alone. If the minerals are good enough and you have enough cargo capacity, you'll still turn a profit. Or if you have a fast ship, you can just run away. Of course, with enough of a fleet you just fight them off." He shakes his head. "Most pirates would be richer and live longer if they just mined instead of extorting merchants and plundering ships."
units.italian: "Puoi sempre corromperli perché ti lascino in pace. Se i minerali sono buoni e hai abbastanza capacità di carico, resti comunque in profitto. Oppure, se hai una nave veloce, puoi semplicemente scappare. Certo, con una flotta abbastanza grande li respingi e basta." Scuote la testa. "La maggior parte dei pirati sarebbe più ricca e vivrebbe più a lungo se estraesse invece di estorcere ai mercanti e saccheggiare le navi."

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"You will learn this by experience, but if the planet has an outfitter, you can check the price there before you sell."|425|0
units.english: "You will learn this by experience, but if the planet has an outfitter, you can check the price there before you sell."
units.italian: "Lo imparerai con l'esperienza, ma se il pianeta ha un fornitore puoi controllare il prezzo là prima di vendere."

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"If you're willing to take me on one more journey," James says, "meet me in the spaceport bar in a little while. Don't forget to sell off your minerals at the trading post, or if there is one, the outfitter."|435|0
units.english: "If you're willing to take me on one more journey," James says, "meet me in the spaceport bar in a little while. Don't forget to sell off your minerals at the trading post, or if there is one, the outfitter."
units.italian: "Se sei disposto a portarmi in un altro viaggio," dice James, "raggiungimi al bar dello spazioporto fra un po'. Non dimenticare di vendere i minerali all'emporio, o dal fornitore, se ce n'è uno."

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	"If you'd rather whet your teeth with some starfighting, come and find me in the spaceport before you leave." He picks up his suitcase and heads outside.|438|0
units.english: "If you'd rather whet your teeth with some starfighting, come and find me in the spaceport before you leave." He picks up his suitcase and heads outside.
units.italian: "Se invece preferisci farti le ossa un po' di combattimento stellare, vieni a cercarmi allo spazioporto prima di partire." Prende la valigia ed esce.

units.id: conversation:mining intro end|	(As before, click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)|440|0
units.english: (As before, click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)
units.italian: (Come prima, per continuare questa missione premi il pulsante "Spazioporto".)

units.id: conversation:mining intro new sahara|You find James sitting at the spaceport's tiny bar, sipping a beer while watching the large displays that show the landing pads and the irrigated fields beyond. The displays are supposed to make the underground building feel less claustrophobic.|444|0
units.english: You find James sitting at the spaceport's tiny bar, sipping a beer while watching the large displays that show the landing pads and the irrigated fields beyond. The displays are supposed to make the underground building feel less claustrophobic.
units.italian: Trovi James seduto al minuscolo bar dello spazioporto, che sorseggia una birra guardando i grandi schermi che mostrano le piazzole e i campi irrigati oltre. Gli schermi dovrebbero far sentire meno claustrofobico l'edificio sotterraneo.

units.id: conversation:mining intro new sahara|	"This is one of the least habitable planets in the galaxy. But if it doesn't kill us instantly, then someone's tried to settle it." He pauses for a moment while gazing at one of the displays. You spot a sandstorm picking up in the far distance as the workers in the fields hastily finish their work before it arrives.|445|0
units.english: "This is one of the least habitable planets in the galaxy. But if it doesn't kill us instantly, then someone's tried to settle it." He pauses for a moment while gazing at one of the displays. You spot a sandstorm picking up in the far distance as the workers in the fields hastily finish their work before it arrives.
units.italian: "Questo è uno dei pianeti meno abitabili della galassia. Ma se non ci uccide subito, qualcuno ha provato a colonizzarlo." Fa una pausa guardando uno degli schermi. Vedi una tempesta di sabbia alzarsi in lontananza mentre gli operai nei campi finiscono in fretta il lavoro prima che arrivi.

units.id: conversation:mining intro new sahara|	"Care for a drink?" he asks.|446|0
units.english: "Care for a drink?" he asks.
units.italian: "Ti va da bere?" chiede.

units.id: conversation:mining intro new sahara|	"Sure."|448|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: conversation:mining intro new sahara|	"No thanks."|449|0
units.english: "No thanks."
units.italian: "No grazie."

units.id: conversation:mining intro new sahara|	He buys you a beer. It tastes a little stale, but it's not the worst beer you've ever had. You can't help but feel sorry for the people who work here, so isolated and cut off from even the basic amenities you took for granted on <home planet>.|451|0
units.english: He buys you a beer. It tastes a little stale, but it's not the worst beer you've ever had. You can't help but feel sorry for the people who work here, so isolated and cut off from even the basic amenities you took for granted on <home planet>.
units.italian: Ti compra una birra. Sa un po' di stantio, ma non è la peggiore che tu abbia mai bevuto. Non puoi fare a meno di dispiacerti per la gente che lavora qui, così isolata e tagliata fuori persino dalle comodità di base che davi per scontate su <home planet>.

units.id: conversation:mining intro new sahara|	"Anyway," says James, "would you be willing to take me on one more journey? It's time for me to head for that retirement home."|453|0
units.english: "Anyway," says James, "would you be willing to take me on one more journey? It's time for me to head for that retirement home."
units.italian: "Comunque," dice James, "saresti disposto a portarmi in un altro viaggio? È tempo che vada in quella casa di riposo."

units.id: conversation:mining intro new sahara|	"Of course."|455|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: conversation:mining intro new sahara|	"Sorry, I think I'll go hunt some pirates instead."|456|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think I'll go hunt some pirates instead."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che andrò a caccia di qualche pirata, invece."

units.id: conversation:mining intro new sahara|	Once again you walk back to your ship with James. Once you get there, as he's stowing his luggage, you pull up the information your computer has on <planet>. It's one of the "Paradise Worlds," terraformed to have a perfect climate, accessible only to the very wealthy. You wonder whether James is going to be able to fit in there.|458|0
units.english: Once again you walk back to your ship with James. Once you get there, as he's stowing his luggage, you pull up the information your computer has on <planet>. It's one of the "Paradise Worlds," terraformed to have a perfect climate, accessible only to the very wealthy. You wonder whether James is going to be able to fit in there.
units.italian: Ancora una volta torni alla nave con James. Una volta arrivati, mentre lui sistema i bagagli, richiami le informazioni che il computer ha su <planet>. È uno dei "Mondi Paradisiaci", terraformato per avere un clima perfetto, accessibile solo ai molto ricchi. Ti chiedi se James riuscirà a inserirsi là.

units.id: conversation:intro relic|You find James talking with a group of dock workers, who seem to be old acquaintances of his. As you approach, he says, "Well guys, here comes my ride. I should probably say goodbye." They head back off to do their work. "Even after all my years as a captain," says James, "I still feel a little sad visiting this world. <origin> was meant to be the future; an evergreen rest station for ships seeking to conquer the great cosmos. But then ships were able to travel for longer and further, and they discovered bigger, greener, more valuable planets, and suddenly the 'future' became little more than a ghost town. Can you imagine spending your life here?"|463|0
units.english: You find James talking with a group of dock workers, who seem to be old acquaintances of his. As you approach, he says, "Well guys, here comes my ride. I should probably say goodbye." They head back off to do their work. "Even after all my years as a captain," says James, "I still feel a little sad visiting this world. <origin> was meant to be the future; an evergreen rest station for ships seeking to conquer the great cosmos. But then ships were able to travel for longer and further, and they discovered bigger, greener, more valuable planets, and suddenly the 'future' became little more than a ghost town. Can you imagine spending your life here?"
units.italian: Trovi James che parla con un gruppo di scaricatori del porto, che sembrano vecchie conoscenze. Mentre ti avvicini dice: "Beh ragazzi, ecco il mio passaggio. Credo che mi convenga salutare." Loro tornano al lavoro. "Anche dopo tutti i miei anni da capitano," dice James, "visitare questo mondo mi rattrista ancora un po'. <origin> doveva essere il futuro: una stazione di sosta sempreverde per le navi che cercavano di conquistare il grande cosmo. Poi le navi hanno cominciato a viaggiare più a lungo e più lontano, hanno scoperto pianeti più grandi, più verdi e più ricchi, e all'improvviso il 'futuro' è diventato poco più di una città fantasma. Riusciresti a immaginare di passare la vita qui?"

units.id: conversation:intro relic|	"It's better than living in poverty on an urban planet."|465|0
units.english: "It's better than living in poverty on an urban planet."
units.italian: "È meglio che vivere in povertà su un pianeta urbano."

units.id: conversation:intro relic|	"No."|466|0
units.english: "No."
units.italian: "No."

units.id: conversation:intro relic|	"I suppose," he says. "Anyway, I think it's time for the last leg of my journey. Do you think you can give me a lift to <planet>? I'll pay you quite well for your services, of course."|468|0
units.english: "I suppose," he says. "Anyway, I think it's time for the last leg of my journey. Do you think you can give me a lift to <planet>? I'll pay you quite well for your services, of course."
units.italian: "Suppongo di sì," dice. "Comunque, credo che sia tempo per l'ultima tappa del mio viaggio. Pensi di potermi portare su <planet>? Ti pagherò molto bene per i tuoi servizi, naturalmente."

units.id: conversation:intro relic|	James cracks a smile at your frankness. "Anyway, I think it's time for the last leg of my journey. Do you think you can give me a lift to <planet>? I'll pay you quite well for your services, of course."|471|0
units.english: James cracks a smile at your frankness. "Anyway, I think it's time for the last leg of my journey. Do you think you can give me a lift to <planet>? I'll pay you quite well for your services, of course."
units.italian: James accenna un sorriso alla tua franchezza. "Comunque, credo che sia tempo per l'ultima tappa del mio viaggio. Pensi di potermi portare su <planet>? Ti pagherò molto bene per i tuoi servizi, naturalmente."

units.id: conversation:intro relic|	"I can take you there."|474|0
units.english: "I can take you there."
units.italian: "Posso portarti là."

units.id: conversation:intro relic|	"Sorry, I was thinking of heading in a different direction from here."|475|0
units.english: "Sorry, I was thinking of heading in a different direction from here."
units.italian: "Spiacente, pensavo di andare in una direzione diversa da qui."

units.id: conversation:intro relic|	Once again you walk back to your ship with James. Once you get there, as he's stowing his luggage, you pull up the information your computer has on <planet>. It's one of the "Paradise Worlds," terraformed to have a perfect climate, accessible only to the very wealthy. You wonder whether James is going to be able to fit in there.|477|0
units.english: Once again you walk back to your ship with James. Once you get there, as he's stowing his luggage, you pull up the information your computer has on <planet>. It's one of the "Paradise Worlds," terraformed to have a perfect climate, accessible only to the very wealthy. You wonder whether James is going to be able to fit in there.
units.italian: Ancora una volta torni alla nave con James. Una volta arrivati, mentre lui sistema i bagagli, richiami le informazioni che il computer ha su <planet>. È uno dei "Mondi Paradisiaci", terraformato per avere un clima perfetto, accessibile solo ai molto ricchi. Ti chiedi se James riuscirà a inserirsi là.

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Fighter]|As you check over the specs of your brand new <flagship model> one last time, you realize it lacks the hyperdrive necessary for interstellar travel! Unless you're happy to spend the rest of your life flying past the same few planets, you'll need to sell the <flagship model> and buy a proper spacefaring vessel.|495|0
units.english: As you check over the specs of your brand new <flagship model> one last time, you realize it lacks the hyperdrive necessary for interstellar travel! Unless you're happy to spend the rest of your life flying past the same few planets, you'll need to sell the <flagship model> and buy a proper spacefaring vessel.
units.italian: Mentre controlli un'ultima volta le specifiche della tua nuovissima <flagship model>, ti accorgi che le manca l'iperguida necessaria ai viaggi interstellari! A meno che tu non voglia passare il resto della vita a volare intorno agli stessi pochi pianeti, dovrai vendere la <flagship model> e comprare un vero vascello spaziale.

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Drone]|You prepare to board your new ship and take it for a test flight, only to find it is an automated drone that lacks a crew compartment entirely! Unless you want to try strapping yourself on the outside of the hull, you'll need to sell off your drone and buy a proper spacefaring vessel.|509|0
units.english: You prepare to board your new ship and take it for a test flight, only to find it is an automated drone that lacks a crew compartment entirely! Unless you want to try strapping yourself on the outside of the hull, you'll need to sell off your drone and buy a proper spacefaring vessel.
units.italian: Ti prepari a salire sulla tua nuova nave e a portarla in volo di prova, solo per scoprire che è un drone automatizzato totalmente privo di cabina per l'equipaggio! A meno che tu non voglia provare a legarti all'esterno dello scafo, dovrai vendere il drone e comprare un vero vascello spaziale.

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|For reasons known only to yourself, you have spent your mortgage on three Mining Drones that are completely useless to you. As you bask in the economic genius of your decision, you hear a merchant haggling with a ship reseller.|531|0
units.english: For reasons known only to yourself, you have spent your mortgage on three Mining Drones that are completely useless to you. As you bask in the economic genius of your decision, you hear a merchant haggling with a ship reseller.
units.italian: Per ragioni che conosci solo tu, hai speso il tuo mutuo in tre droni minerari del tutto inutili. Mentre ti crogioli nel genio economico della tua decisione, senti un mercante che contratta con un rivenditore di navi.

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	"Look, you'd have to be looking real close to tell that she's a pre-loved ship. Plus, she isn't 'outdated,' she's an antique! Ship collectors will be throwing their wallets at you just to get a photo of the ship."|532|0
units.english: "Look, you'd have to be looking real close to tell that she's a pre-loved ship. Plus, she isn't 'outdated,' she's an antique! Ship collectors will be throwing their wallets at you just to get a photo of the ship."
units.italian: "Senti, dovresti guardarla molto da vicino per capire che è una nave già amata. E poi non è 'obsoleta', è un pezzo d'antiquariato! I collezionisti di navi ti getteranno addosso i loro portafogli solo per una foto della nave."

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	The reseller is unamused by the merchant's arguments and takes his leave when it becomes clear neither side is willing to compromise. Exhausted, the merchant slumps onto a nearby bench.|533|0
units.english: The reseller is unamused by the merchant's arguments and takes his leave when it becomes clear neither side is willing to compromise. Exhausted, the merchant slumps onto a nearby bench.
units.italian: Il rivenditore non è divertito dagli argomenti del mercante e se ne va quando diventa chiaro che nessuna delle due parti è disposta a cedere. Sfinito, il mercante si lascia cadere su una panchina vicina.

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	(Approach the merchant.)|535|0
units.english: (Approach the merchant.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati al mercante.)

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	(Ignore the merchant so I can appreciate my Mining Drones more.)|536|0
units.english: (Ignore the merchant so I can appreciate my Mining Drones more.)
units.italian: (Ignora il mercante così posso ammirare meglio i miei droni minerari.)

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	You take a seat on the bench and ask, "What was that all about?"|538|0
units.english: You take a seat on the bench and ask, "What was that all about?"
units.italian: Ti siedi sulla panchina e chiedi: "Che cosa succedeva?"

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	The merchant turns his head to face you. "That whole kerfuffle? Tried to cheat me out of a fair deal, he did." Seeing your confusion, he elaborates. "I'm a space miner by trade. A few days ago, I got caught in a nasty pirate ambush - lost all my Mining Drones in the blink of an eye. The pirates weren't doing so hot either, though. I got lucky and managed to disable and capture a Jackal, one of those old, Caravan-era interceptors. I thought I'd sell it off and replace my drones, but the shipyards here are running a racket; I can't even buy half a Mining Drone with the credits they're offering." He lets out a sigh.|539|0
units.english: The merchant turns his head to face you. "That whole kerfuffle? Tried to cheat me out of a fair deal, he did." Seeing your confusion, he elaborates. "I'm a space miner by trade. A few days ago, I got caught in a nasty pirate ambush - lost all my Mining Drones in the blink of an eye. The pirates weren't doing so hot either, though. I got lucky and managed to disable and capture a Jackal, one of those old, Caravan-era interceptors. I thought I'd sell it off and replace my drones, but the shipyards here are running a racket; I can't even buy half a Mining Drone with the credits they're offering." He lets out a sigh.
units.italian: Il mercante gira la testa verso di te. "Quel parapiglia? Ha cercato di fregarmi su un affare onesto, ecco cosa." Vedendo la tua confusione, si spiega meglio. "Faccio il minatore spaziale di mestiere. Qualche giorno fa sono finito in un'imboscata di pirati, brutta assai: ho perso tutti i miei droni minerari in un batter d'occhio. Però anche i pirati non se la passavano bene. Ho avuto fortuna e sono riuscito a disattivare e catturare un Jackal, uno di quei vecchi intercettori dell'epoca Caravan. Pensavo di venderlo e rimpiazzare i droni, ma i cantieri qui fanno cartello: con i crediti che offrono non ci compro nemmeno mezzo drone minerario." Sospira.

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	"Actually, I have some spare Mining Drones."|541|0
units.english: "Actually, I have some spare Mining Drones."
units.italian: "In realtà ho qualche drone minerario di scorta."

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	"Thanks for the story, but I have places to be."|543|0
units.english: "Thanks for the story, but I have places to be."
units.italian: "Grazie della storia, ma ho posti dove devo essere."

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	"Well, thanks for listening." The merchant bids you farewell as you stand up and leave.|544|0
units.english: "Well, thanks for listening." The merchant bids you farewell as you stand up and leave.
units.italian: "Beh, grazie per avermi ascoltato." Il mercante ti saluta mentre ti alzi e te ne vai.

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	The merchant's head perks up. "Really? That's fantastic!" He quietly mutters some numbers to himself, then says, "How about two Mining Drones for the Jackal? You think that's a fair deal?"|547|0
units.english: The merchant's head perks up. "Really? That's fantastic!" He quietly mutters some numbers to himself, then says, "How about two Mining Drones for the Jackal? You think that's a fair deal?"
units.italian: Il mercante drizza la testa. "Davvero? È fantastico!" Borbotta qualche numero fra sé, poi dice: "Che ne dici di due droni minerari per il Jackal? Ti sembra un affare onesto?"

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	"Sounds good."|549|0
units.english: "Sounds good."
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene."

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	"What about just one drone?"|551|0
units.english: "What about just one drone?"
units.italian: "E con un solo drone?"

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	"I can't take that deal."|552|0
units.english: "I can't take that deal."
units.italian: "Non posso accettare."

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	He shakes his head. "It's got to be two drones, or no drones."|554|0
units.english: He shakes his head. "It's got to be two drones, or no drones."
units.italian: Scuote la testa. "O due droni, o niente droni."

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	"Alright, you'll have your drones."|556|0
units.english: "Alright, you'll have your drones."
units.italian: "Va bene, avrai i tuoi droni."

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	"No deal."|558|0
units.english: "No deal."
units.italian: "Niente affare."

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	"Darn. Well, at least you've given me an idea; there's got to be a captain out there willing to hand me a couple of Mining Drones for my Jackal!" The merchant hops up from the bench and jauntily walks away.|560|0
units.english: "Darn. Well, at least you've given me an idea; there's got to be a captain out there willing to hand me a couple of Mining Drones for my Jackal!" The merchant hops up from the bench and jauntily walks away.
units.italian: "Accidenti. Beh, almeno mi hai dato un'idea: ci sarà pure un capitano là fuori disposto a darmi un paio di droni minerari per il mio Jackal!" Il mercante salta giù dalla panchina e se ne va con disinvoltura.

units.id: mission:Intro [0 Jackal]|	You shake hands with the merchant. "Thanks for the deal, partner." He hands you the license to the Jackal and walks off towards the loading bays to claim his new Mining Drones.|567|0
units.english: You shake hands with the merchant. "Thanks for the deal, partner." He hands you the license to the Jackal and walks off towards the loading bays to claim his new Mining Drones.
units.italian: Stringi la mano al mercante. "Grazie dell'affare, socio." Ti consegna la licenza del Jackal e si avvia verso le baie di carico per prendere i suoi nuovi droni minerari.

units.id: mission:Intro [0]|name|580|0
units.english: Passenger to <planet>
units.italian: Passeggero per <planet>

units.id: mission:Intro [0]|description|581|0
units.english: This old-timer captain offered to ride along with you to <destination>, and to give you some tips along the way.
units.italian: Questo capitano veterano si è offerto di viaggiare con te fino a <destination> e di darti qualche dritta lungo la strada.

units.id: mission:Intro [0]|log|598|0
units.english: Getting some basic instructions on making a living as a merchant from an old captain named James.
units.italian: Ricevo qualche istruzione di base su come guadagnarsi da vivere da mercante da un vecchio capitano di nome James.

units.id: mission:Intro [0]|log|599|0
units.english: An old man who accompanied you on your first few jobs as a starship captain.
units.italian: Un vecchio che mi ha accompagnato nei miei primi lavori come capitano di nave stellare.

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|name|609|0
units.english: Transport family to <planet>
units.italian: Trasportare la famiglia su <planet>

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|description|610|0
units.english: Bring your new friend James, along with this large family, to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>.
units.italian: Porta il tuo nuovo amico James, insieme a questa numerosa famiglia, su <destination>. Il pagamento sarà <payment>.

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|blocked|611|0
units.english: When you meet up with James in the spaceport, he says, "Hi there, <first>! I found you another mission, but it looks like you'll need <capacity> in order to take it on. So, you'll either have to cancel another mission, or come back here later to continue this one. Sorry!"
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ti ho trovato un'altra missione, ma a quanto pare ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|You begin strolling through the spaceport, walking briskly in order to keep warm and wondering if it might be worth investing in a good winter coat for visiting planets like this one. Eventually you find James. He has an entire family in tow: a young couple, an elderly woman, and three children who range in age from probably about three or four up to twelve or thirteen.|627|0
units.english: You begin strolling through the spaceport, walking briskly in order to keep warm and wondering if it might be worth investing in a good winter coat for visiting planets like this one. Eventually you find James. He has an entire family in tow: a young couple, an elderly woman, and three children who range in age from probably about three or four up to twelve or thirteen.
units.italian: Cominci a girare per lo spazioporto, camminando svelto per restare al caldo e chiedendoti se non valga la pena investire in un buon cappotto invernale per visitare pianeti come questo. Alla fine trovi James. Ha al seguito un'intera famiglia: una giovane coppia, una donna anziana e tre bambini che vanno da forse tre o quattro anni fino a dodici o tredici.

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|	"Captain <last>!" he says. "Wonderful to see you again. I was just talking to this family. They've been having trouble finding a single ship that can give them all passage, but I told them that your shuttlecraft has plenty of bunks, at least if the kids triple up. They can pay you <payment> to take them to <planet>, which is just a few jumps away from Earth, and is a planet well worth visiting in its own right. What do you say?"|628|0
units.english: "Captain <last>!" he says. "Wonderful to see you again. I was just talking to this family. They've been having trouble finding a single ship that can give them all passage, but I told them that your shuttlecraft has plenty of bunks, at least if the kids triple up. They can pay you <payment> to take them to <planet>, which is just a few jumps away from Earth, and is a planet well worth visiting in its own right. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Capitano <last>!" dice. "Che bello rivederti. Stavo proprio parlando con questa famiglia. Hanno avuto difficoltà a trovare una sola nave che potesse dare passaggio a tutti, ma ho detto loro che la tua navetta ha parecchi posti letto, almeno se i bambini si mettono in tre per uno. Possono pagarti <payment> per portarli su <planet>, che è a pochi salti dalla Terra ed è un pianeta che vale la visita di per sé. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|	You're absolutely sure that your shuttle was not designed to fit eight people including yourself, but if they're willing to squeeze into the available five bunks you've got no reason to discourage them.|629|0
units.english: You're absolutely sure that your shuttle was not designed to fit eight people including yourself, but if they're willing to squeeze into the available five bunks you've got no reason to discourage them.
units.italian: Sei assolutamente sicuro che la tua navetta non sia progettata per otto persone, te compreso, ma se sono disposti a stiparsi nei cinque posti letto disponibili non hai motivo di scoraggiarli.

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|	"Welcome aboard!"|631|0
units.english: "Welcome aboard!"
units.italian: "Benvenuti a bordo!"

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|	"Sorry, I think I'd rather go off in my own direction from here."|632|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think I'd rather go off in my own direction from here."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che preferirei andare per la mia direzione da qui."

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|	James helps the older woman up the steps and into your ship while the younger family members carry the luggage. You are going to have quite a full ship for the next few days.|634|0
units.english: James helps the older woman up the steps and into your ship while the younger family members carry the luggage. You are going to have quite a full ship for the next few days.
units.italian: James aiuta la donna anziana a salire i gradini ed entrare nella nave mentre i familiari più giovani portano i bagagli. Avrai la nave bella piena per i prossimi giorni.

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|Along the journey, you learned that the family you are transporting are named the Hendersons, and that they are moving to <planet> mostly because they hope the urban setting will be better for their kids than <origin>, where there were hardly any children at all and their village had only a few thousand people in it. The grandmother, Olivia, has also been chattering nonstop about how excited she is about being on a world where she can actually go sunbathing: "I've gotten much too old for snowshoeing," she says.|640|0
units.english: Along the journey, you learned that the family you are transporting are named the Hendersons, and that they are moving to <planet> mostly because they hope the urban setting will be better for their kids than <origin>, where there were hardly any children at all and their village had only a few thousand people in it. The grandmother, Olivia, has also been chattering nonstop about how excited she is about being on a world where she can actually go sunbathing: "I've gotten much too old for snowshoeing," she says.
units.italian: Lungo il viaggio scopri che la famiglia che stai trasportando si chiama Henderson, e che si trasferiscono su <planet> soprattutto perché sperano che l'ambiente urbano sia meglio per i loro figli di <origin>, dove non c'erano quasi bambini e il loro villaggio contava solo qualche migliaio di abitanti. Anche la nonna, Olivia, non ha smesso un attimo di cianciare di quanto sia entusiasta di stare su un mondo dove può davvero prendere il sole: "Sono diventata troppo vecchia per le racchette da neve," dice.

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Transport]|	You say goodbye to them and wish them well, and as agreed they pay you <payment>. You are already well on your way towards paying down your mortgage!|641|0

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Transport]|It doesn't take you long to find James in the <origin> spaceport. He's already got a small group of people with him: a middle-aged couple, and a teenage boy. "Hi there, Captain <last>!" says James. "Interested in carrying some tourists to <planet>?"|661|0

units.italian: Non ti serve molto per trovare James nello spazioporto di <origin>. Ha già con sé un piccolo gruppo: una coppia di mezza età e un ragazzo adolescente. "Buongiorno, Capitano <last>!" dice James. "Ti va di portare qualche turista su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Transport]|	"Sure!"|663|0
units.english: "Sure!"
units.italian: "Certo!"

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Transport]|	"No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."|664|0

units.italian: "No grazie, credo che ora andrò per conto mio."

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Transport]|	"Great," he says. "This is Chuck, Sarah, and their son Carl. Let's help them carry their luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of them, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time."|666|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "This is Chuck, Sarah, and their son Carl. Let's help them carry their luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of them, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Loro sono Chuck, Sarah e loro figlio Carl. Aiutiamoli a portare i bagagli alla tua nave." Mentre tornate indietro, tu leggermente davanti a loro, James ti sussurra: "I turisti sono sempre un buon modo di fare soldi. Sono in vacanza, quindi non dispiacciono a pagare un po' di più. Ma non ha senso sprecare spazio in stiva, quindi dai un'occhiata alla bacheca degli incarichi e vedi se ci sono consegne da fare nello stesso viaggio."

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Transport]|As you make the final landing descent to the surface of <planet>, Chuck and Sarah stare out the window in rapt attention, pointing out landmarks on the planet's surface. James joins in by telling you all about some of the history of the cities you are flying over. Carl, meanwhile, has spent the entire journey playing a video game, and only glances out the window when the ship shakes from turbulence. As they all grab their luggage and step off your ship to explore humanity's homeworld, he is still immersed in the game.|672|0
units.english: As you make the final landing descent to the surface of <planet>, Chuck and Sarah stare out the window in rapt attention, pointing out landmarks on the planet's surface. James joins in by telling you all about some of the history of the cities you are flying over. Carl, meanwhile, has spent the entire journey playing a video game, and only glances out the window when the ship shakes from turbulence. As they all grab their luggage and step off your ship to explore humanity's homeworld, he is still immersed in the game.
units.italian: Mentre fai l'ultima discesa verso la superficie di <planet>, Chuck e Sarah fissano il finestrino con attenzione rapita, indicando i punti di riferimento sulla superficie del pianeta. James si unisce raccontandoti un po' della storia delle città che stai sorvolando. Carl, invece, ha passato tutto il viaggio a giocare a un videogioco e guarda fuori dal finestrino solo quando la nave trema per la turbolenza. Mentre prendono i bagagli e scendono dalla nave per esplorare il mondo natale dell'umanità, è ancora immerso nel gioco.

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Transport]|	As you collect your payment, James pulls the parents aside and says, "Watch out for pickpockets, okay? And take it from an experienced captain, you do not want to be out after dark here. Play it safe, and have a great time."|673|0
units.english: As you collect your payment, James pulls the parents aside and says, "Watch out for pickpockets, okay? And take it from an experienced captain, you do not want to be out after dark here. Play it safe, and have a great time."
units.italian: Mentre incassi il pagamento, James prende da parte i genitori e dice: "Attenti ai borsaioli, intesi? E credetemi, da capitano esperto: non volete restare fuori dopo il buio, qui. Andate sul sicuro e divertitevi."

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Transport]|	After they leave, James shakes his head ruefully. "It'll probably be a decade before that kid is old enough to realize what he's missing out on. Waste of money, doing a trip like this with a teenage boy. They should've gone to Skymoot and seen the dragons instead; I'm sure that would interest him a lot more than historical museums and ancient cities." Then, he picks up his luggage and adds, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."|674|0
units.english: After they leave, James shakes his head ruefully. "It'll probably be a decade before that kid is old enough to realize what he's missing out on. Waste of money, doing a trip like this with a teenage boy. They should've gone to Skymoot and seen the dragons instead; I'm sure that would interest him a lot more than historical museums and ancient cities." Then, he picks up his luggage and adds, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Dopo che se ne sono andati, James scuote la testa con amarezza. "Passerà probabilmente un decennio prima che quel ragazzo sia abbastanza grande da capire cosa si sta perdendo. Un viaggio così con un adolescente è denaro buttato. Sarebbero dovuti andare su Skymoot a vedere i draghi; sono sicuro che lo interesserebbe molto più dei musei storici e delle città antiche." Poi prende i bagagli e aggiunge: "Stesso accordo di prima. Se vuoi continuare a viaggiare insieme, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Freighter]|	"It is indeed," he says, "but a lucrative one. <cargo> needs to get to <planet> while it's still fresh, and that means it needs to be there no later than <day>. units.english: "It is indeed," he says, "but a lucrative one. <cargo> needs to get to <planet> while it's still fresh, and that means it needs to be there no later than <day>. If we take a direct route, there should be no trouble making the delivery on time. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Lo è davvero," dice, "ma è redditizio. <cargo> deve arrivare su <planet> finché è ancora fresco, e questo significa che deve essere là non più tardi del <day>. Se prendiamo una rotta diretta, non dovremmo avere problemi a consegnare in tempo. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Sounds good. Let's do it!"|758|0
units.english: "Sounds good. Let's do it!"
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene. Facciamolo!"

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Freighter]|	"No way am I loading up my shiny new starship with smelly fish. Count me out."|759|0
units.english: "No way am I loading up my shiny new starship with smelly fish. Count me out."
units.italian: "Non se ne parla di caricare pesce puzzolente sulla mia nave stellare nuova di zecca. Senza di me."

units.id: mission:Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Great!" he says. "I mentioned this earlier, but you might want to stop by the outfitter and buy a local map. units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice. "L'ho già detto prima, ma potresti passare dal fornitore e comprare una mappa locale. Le rotte dell'iperspazio non sono sempre logiche, e l'ultima cosa che vuoi è perderti e ritrovarti con un mucchio di pesce marcio che nessuno vuole a riempire la stiva."

units.italian: Trovi James in piedi su una piazzola sotto un grande mercantile, che chiacchiera con un uomo che supponi sia il capitano. "Eccoti!" dice. "Il capitano Eldred qui dice che le sue due navi hanno problemi con i pirati da quando hanno lasciato il Rim dieci giorni fa, e cerca una scorta per portarle sane e salve su Gemstone. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"Of course!"|831|0
units.english: "Of course!"
units.italian: "Certamente!"

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"No, sounds a bit too risky for me."|832|0

units.italian: "No, mi sembra troppo rischioso per me."

units.id: mission:Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"Great," he says. "Whenever we're ready to leave the planet, they'll take off behind us and follow us to <planet>." As you begin walking away together, he adds in a quieter voice, "Normally a fresh pilot like you with no combat reputation would never be offered a mission like this, so try not to mess things up. Remember that we don't have to kill the pirates, all we have to do is make sure the convoy isn't destroyed. But freighters are slow, so you can't just go skipping through hyperspace as fast as you want; you need to stick around and make sure they're behind you."|834|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "Whenever we're ready to leave the planet, they'll take off behind us and follow us to <planet>." As you begin walking away together, he adds in a quieter voice, "Normally a fresh pilot like you with no combat reputation would never be offered a mission like this, so try not to mess things up. Remember that we don't have to kill the pirates, all we have to do is make sure the convoy isn't destroyed. But freighters are slow, so you can't just go skipping through hyperspace as fast as you want; you need to stick around and make sure they're behind you."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Quando saremo pronti a lasciare il pianeta, decolleranno dietro di noi e ci seguiranno fino a <planet>." Mentre vi allontanate insieme, aggiunge a voce più bassa: "Normalmente a un pilota fresco come te, senza reputazione in combattimento, non verrebbe mai offerta una missione così, quindi cerca di non combinare pasticci. Ricorda che non dobbiamo uccidere i pirati: dobbiamo solo assicurarci che il convoglio non venga distrutto. Ma i mercantili sono lenti, quindi non puoi saltare per l'iperspazio come ti pare e piace: devi restare nei paraggi e assicurarti che siano dietro di te."

units.italian: Trovi James con quattro persone di mezza età al seguito. "Capitano <last>!" dice. "Che bello rivederti. Stavo proprio parlando con questi scienziati. Hanno avuto difficoltà a trovare una nave disposta a fare scalo su un mondo di basso profilo come <planet>. Possono pagarti <payment> per portarli là. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Transport]|	"Welcome aboard!"|977|0

units.italian: "Benvenuti a bordo!"

units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che preferirei andare per la mia direzione da qui."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Transport]|	You and James direct the team to your ship. Looks like you're about to set off on your first real job...|980|0
units.english: You and James direct the team to your ship. Looks like you're about to set off on your first real job...
units.italian: Tu e James indirizzate la squadra verso la tua nave. Sembra che tu stia per partire per il tuo primo lavoro serio...

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Transport]|Along the journey, you learned that the team of scientists you are transporting are studying indigenous life on sub-arctic worlds. <planet> is of particular interest to them, as it hosts a variety of colorful organisms, from the six-winged albatross to the all-consuming Ice-Slug. "<planet> is also a planet of great historical importance," one of the scientists says. "A bacterium living in its wilderness was able to bring the Rigellian Plague to an end four centuries ago. Before then, entire colonies could be wiped out by a single infected ship."|986|0
units.english: Along the journey, you learned that the team of scientists you are transporting are studying indigenous life on sub-arctic worlds. <planet> is of particular interest to them, as it hosts a variety of colorful organisms, from the six-winged albatross to the all-consuming Ice-Slug. "<planet> is also a planet of great historical importance," one of the scientists says. "A bacterium living in its wilderness was able to bring the Rigellian Plague to an end four centuries ago. Before then, entire colonies could be wiped out by a single infected ship."
units.italian: Lungo il viaggio scopri che la squadra di scienziati che stai trasportando studia la vita indigena sui mondi subartici. <planet> li interessa in modo particolare, perché ospita una varietà di organismi colorati, dall'albatro a sei ali alla Lumaca di Ghiaccio che divora tutto. "<planet> è anche un pianeta di grande importanza storica," dice uno degli scienziati. "Un batterio che vive nelle sue terre selvagge è riuscito a porre fine alla Peste Rigelliana quattro secoli fa. Prima di allora, intere colonie potevano essere spazzate via da una sola nave infetta."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Transport]|	You say goodbye to them and wish them well, and as agreed they pay you <payment>. You are already well on your way towards paying down your mortgage!|987|0
units.english: You say goodbye to them and wish them well, and as agreed they pay you <payment>. You are already well on your way towards paying down your mortgage!
units.italian: Li saluti e auguri loro ogni bene, e come concordato ti pagano <payment>. Sei già ben avviato a estinguere il mutuo!

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Transport]|	As James leaves the ship, he says, "Again, if you're okay with continuing to give me a ride, just meet me in the spaceport."|988|0
units.english: As James leaves the ship, he says, "Again, if you're okay with continuing to give me a ride, just meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Mentre James lascia la nave, dice: "Di nuovo: se ti va di continuare a darmi un passaggio, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Transport]|	(As before, click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)|990|0
units.english: (As before, click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)
units.italian: (Come prima, per continuare questa missione premi il pulsante "Spazioporto".)

units.italian: Turisti per <planet>

units.italian: Questi turisti ti pagheranno <payment> per portarli su <destination>. Anche il tuo nuovo amico James verrà con voi.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport]|<origin>'s spaceport is far colder than anything you've experienced; you try to insulate yourself with what you have as nearby vendors peddle overpriced coats. Despite its size, the port is almost completely empty. Many storefronts have been shuttered, and the provided seating looks brand-new and outdated at the same time.|1007|0
units.english: <origin>'s spaceport is far colder than anything you've experienced; you try to insulate yourself with what you have as nearby vendors peddle overpriced coats. Despite its size, the port is almost completely empty. Many storefronts have been shuttered, and the provided seating looks brand-new and outdated at the same time.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di <origin> è molto più freddo di qualsiasi cosa tu abbia mai provato; cerchi di isolarti come puoi mentre i venditori lì intorno smerciano cappotti a prezzi esagerati. Nonostante le dimensioni, il porto è quasi completamente vuoto. Molte vetrine sono state sbarrate, e le sedute messe a disposizione sembrano nuove di zecca e superate allo stesso tempo.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport]|	By the time you see James, he's already got a small group of people with him: a middle-aged couple and a teenage boy. "Hi there, Captain <last>!" says James. "Interested in carrying some tourists to <planet>?"|1008|0
units.english: By the time you see James, he's already got a small group of people with him: a middle-aged couple and a teenage boy. "Hi there, Captain <last>!" says James. "Interested in carrying some tourists to <planet>?"
units.italian: Quando vedi James, ha già con sé un piccolo gruppo: una coppia di mezza età e un ragazzo adolescente. "Buongiorno, Capitano <last>!" dice James. "Ti va di portare qualche turista su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport]|	"Sure!"|1010|0
units.english: "Sure!"
units.italian: "Certo!"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport]|	"No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."|1011|0
units.english: "No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."
units.italian: "No grazie, credo che ora andrò per conto mio."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport]|	"Great," he says. "This is Chai, Simon, and their son Kamon. Let's help them carry their luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of them, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time.|1013|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "This is Chai, Simon, and their son Kamon. Let's help them carry their luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of them, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time.
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Loro sono Chai, Simon e loro figlio Kamon. Aiutiamoli a portare i bagagli alla tua nave." Mentre tornate indietro, tu leggermente davanti a loro, James ti sussurra: "I turisti sono sempre un buon modo di fare soldi. Sono in vacanza, quindi non dispiacciono a pagare un po' di più. Ma non ha senso sprecare spazio in stiva, quindi dai un'occhiata alla bacheca degli incarichi e vedi se ci sono consegne da fare nello stesso viaggio.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport]|	"Make sure your jobs go to the same planet, though; there's two habitable planets in the system of <system>, and landing on <planet> won't complete any missions with Vail as a destination."|1014|0
units.english: "Make sure your jobs go to the same planet, though; there's two habitable planets in the system of <system>, and landing on <planet> won't complete any missions with Vail as a destination."
units.italian: "Assicurati però che i tuoi lavori vadano sullo stesso pianeta: nel sistema <system> ci sono due pianeti abitabili, e atterrare su <planet> non completerà nessuna missione che abbia Vail come destinazione."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport]|Calda is everything Nifel is not. The planet is warm, wet, and filled to the brim with obnoxious tourists. Shortly after you disembark, you are approached by half a dozen salespeople talking over each other as they promote their company's luxury hotels and hot springs. When Chai, Simon, and Kamon step off, the marketeers realize their mistake and begin harassing them instead.|1020|0
units.english: Calda is everything Nifel is not. The planet is warm, wet, and filled to the brim with obnoxious tourists. Shortly after you disembark, you are approached by half a dozen salespeople talking over each other as they promote their company's luxury hotels and hot springs. When Chai, Simon, and Kamon step off, the marketeers realize their mistake and begin harassing them instead.
units.italian: Calda è tutto quello che Nifel non è. Il pianeta è caldo, umido e pieno zeppo di turisti molesti. Poco dopo essere sceso, ti avvicinano una mezza dozzina di venditori che si sovrappongono l'uno all'altro mentre promuovono gli hotel di lusso e le sorgenti termali della loro azienda. Quando Chai, Simon e Kamon scendono, gli addetti al marketing capiscono l'errore e cominciano a molestare loro.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport]|	While Chai is busy handling them, Simon hands you the payment for the trip. As they walk away, you see a spaceport cleaner accidentally back into Kamon while wiping down a bench. A nearby couple in swimsuits spots the incident and starts chewing out the cleaner.|1021|0
units.english: While Chai is busy handling them, Simon hands you the payment for the trip. As they walk away, you see a spaceport cleaner accidentally back into Kamon while wiping down a bench. A nearby couple in swimsuits spots the incident and starts chewing out the cleaner.
units.italian: Mentre Chai è impegnata a gestirli, Simon ti consegna il pagamento del viaggio. Mentre si allontanano, vedi un addetto alle pulizie dello spazioporto urtare per sbaglio Kamon mentre pulisce una panchina. Una coppia lì vicino, in costume da bagno, nota l'incidente e comincia a rimbrottare l'addetto.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport]|	After the commotion clears, James shakes his head and says, "Some people don't have the first clue about how good they have it." Then, he turns to you and says, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."|1022|0
units.english: After the commotion clears, James shakes his head and says, "Some people don't have the first clue about how good they have it." Then, he turns to you and says, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Quando il trambusto si calma, James scuote la testa e dice: "Certa gente non ha la minima idea di quanto sia fortunata." Poi si volta verso di te e dice: "Stesso accordo di prima. Se vuoi continuare a viaggiare insieme, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ho un'ultima missione per te, ma ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [3 Transport]|By the time you find James, it is already night. You find him overlooking a cliff face covered with hot tubs. A number of the pools are coated in shimmering platinum; the rest must settle with mere gold. The patrons enjoying the tubs range from old couples enjoying their retirement to inebriated teenagers wildly swinging their heads. Overhead, an aerobatics show leaves trails of light in the air, forming shapes and names. Below, in one of the tubs, you spot cleaners in drenched overalls draining a pool stained puke-yellow. In another, you see a waitress accosted by a red-faced man in a red business suit.|1040|0
units.english: By the time you find James, it is already night. You find him overlooking a cliff face covered with hot tubs. A number of the pools are coated in shimmering platinum; the rest must settle with mere gold. The patrons enjoying the tubs range from old couples enjoying their retirement to inebriated teenagers wildly swinging their heads. Overhead, an aerobatics show leaves trails of light in the air, forming shapes and names. Below, in one of the tubs, you spot cleaners in drenched overalls draining a pool stained puke-yellow. In another, you see a waitress accosted by a red-faced man in a red business suit.
units.italian: Quando trovi James è già notte. Lo trovi che guarda una parete di scogliera coperta di vasche idromassaggio. Diverse piscine sono rivestite di platino scintillante; le altre devono accontentarsi del semplice oro. I clienti che godono le vasche vanno da anziane coppie in pensione ad adolescenti ubriachi che dondolano la testa in modo scomposto. Sopra la testa, uno spettacolo di acrobazia aerea lascia scie di luce nell'aria, formando figure e nomi. Sotto, in una delle vasche, scorgi degli addetti in tuta fradicia che svuotano una piscina macchiata di giallo-vomito. In un'altra, vedi una cameriera aggredita da un uomo paonazzo in completo rosso.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [3 Transport]|	"It's hardly a wonder why they call them the 'Paradise Worlds,'" James says. "Nine planets, including Calda, each terraformed to perfection. Life on one of these worlds is the most sought-after commodity in the galaxy. But behind each of these worlds, millions of workers toil night and day to maintain a utopia that they will never enjoy."|1041|0
units.english: "It's hardly a wonder why they call them the 'Paradise Worlds,'" James says. "Nine planets, including Calda, each terraformed to perfection. Life on one of these worlds is the most sought-after commodity in the galaxy. But behind each of these worlds, millions of workers toil night and day to maintain a utopia that they will never enjoy."
units.italian: "Non c'è da meravigliarsi che li chiamino i 'Mondi Paradisiaci'," dice James. "Nove pianeti, compresa Calda, ognuno terraformato alla perfezione. La vita su uno di questi mondi è la merce più ambita della galassia. Ma dietro ognuno di questi mondi milioni di lavoratori faticano giorno e notte per mantenere un'utopia di cui non godranno mai."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [3 Transport]|	After taking one last glance at the cliff, he says, "But that's enough of an old man's hypocritical ramblings. Are you willing to take me on one last trip? I need to get to <destination>, and of course I'll pay you quite well to take me there."|1042|0
units.english: After taking one last glance at the cliff, he says, "But that's enough of an old man's hypocritical ramblings. Are you willing to take me on one last trip? I need to get to <destination>, and of course I'll pay you quite well to take me there."
units.italian: Dopo un ultimo sguardo alla scogliera, dice: "Ma basta con le prediche ipocrite di un vecchio. Sei disposto a portarmi in un ultimo viaggio? Devo arrivare su <destination>, e naturalmente ti pagherò molto bene per portarmi là."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [3 Transport]|	"Of course."|1044|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [3 Transport]|	"Sorry, but I was planning on heading out in a different direction from here."|1045|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I was planning on heading out in a different direction from here."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma pensavo di andare in una direzione diversa da qui."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [3 Transport]|	Once again you walk back to your ship with James. Once you get there, as he's stowing his luggage, you pull up the information your computer has on <planet>. It's another member of the "Paradise Worlds," and a retirement home for some of the richest people in the Republic. You wonder whether James is going to be able to fit in there.|1047|0
units.english: Once again you walk back to your ship with James. Once you get there, as he's stowing his luggage, you pull up the information your computer has on <planet>. It's another member of the "Paradise Worlds," and a retirement home for some of the richest people in the Republic. You wonder whether James is going to be able to fit in there.
units.italian: Ancora una volta torni alla nave con James. Una volta arrivati, mentre lui sistema i bagagli, richiami le informazioni che il computer ha su <planet>. È un altro membro dei "Mondi Paradisiaci", e una casa di riposo per alcune delle persone più ricche della Repubblica. Ti chiedi se James riuscirà a inserirsi là.

The system of <system> has two inhabited planets, Muspel and <planet>, and you don't want to land on the wrong planet when trying to finish a job."
units.italian: Tu e James indirizzate Chen verso la tua nave. Dopo che è salito, James si volta verso di te e dice: "Fa' attenzione a dove atterri. Il sistema <system> ha due pianeti abitati, Muspel e <planet>, e non vuoi atterrare sul pianeta sbagliato quando cerchi di completare un lavoro."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Transport Alt]|Just before you enter <planet>'s atmosphere, you open your loading bay ramp, as directed by Chen. units.english: Just before you enter <planet>'s atmosphere, you open your loading bay ramp, as directed by Chen. Shortly afterward, they appear on your cargo hold camera in full skydiving garb. They take a running start and launch themself into space, quickly vanishing from your vision.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Transport Alt]|	Several minutes after your ship touches down, Chen approaches you in the spaceport, thanks you, and hands you <payment>. You are already well on your way towards paying down your mortgage!|1093|0

units.italian: Diversi minuti dopo che la nave si è posata, Chen ti avvicina nello spazioporto, ti ringrazia e ti consegna <payment>. Sei già ben avviato a estinguere il mutuo!

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Transport Alt]|	As James leaves the ship, he says, "Again, if you're okay with continuing to give me a ride, just meet me in the spaceport."|1094|0
units.english: As James leaves the ship, he says, "Again, if you're okay with continuing to give me a ride, just meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Mentre James lascia la nave, dice: "Di nuovo: se ti va di continuare a darmi un passaggio, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport Alt]|The smell of brine permeates <origin>'s spaceport. By the time you find James, it seems unlikely that you'll ever eat seafood without gagging again. "Hi there, Captain <last>!" he says. "Interested in carrying a returning tourist to <planet>?" Behind him is a young man in red sunglasses.|1113|0
units.english: The smell of brine permeates <origin>'s spaceport. By the time you find James, it seems unlikely that you'll ever eat seafood without gagging again. "Hi there, Captain <last>!" he says. "Interested in carrying a returning tourist to <planet>?" Behind him is a young man in red sunglasses.
units.italian: L'odore di salamoia impregna lo spazioporto di <origin>. Quando trovi James, sembra improbabile che tu possa mai più mangiare frutti di mare senza avere conati. "Buongiorno, Capitano <last>!" dice. "Ti va di portare un turista di ritorno su <planet>?" Dietro di lui c'è un giovane con occhiali da sole rossi.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	"Sure!"|1115|0
units.english: "Sure!"
units.italian: "Certo!"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	"No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."|1116|0
units.english: "No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."
units.italian: "No grazie, credo che ora andrò per conto mio."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	"Great," he says. "This is Van. Let's help him carry his luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of them, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money, especially if you're low on bunk space. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time."|1118|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "This is Van. Let's help him carry his luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of them, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money, especially if you're low on bunk space. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Lui è Van. Aiutiamolo a portare i bagagli alla tua nave." Mentre tornate indietro, tu leggermente davanti a loro, James ti sussurra: "I turisti sono sempre un buon modo di fare soldi, soprattutto se hai poco spazio per i posti letto. Sono in vacanza, quindi non dispiacciono a pagare un po' di più. Ma non ha senso sprecare spazio in stiva, quindi dai un'occhiata alla bacheca degli incarichi e vedi se ci sono consegne da fare nello stesso viaggio."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport Alt]|As you make the final landing descent to the surface of Earth, Van looks down on its cluttered surface and begins listing off places he recognizes. units.english: As you make the final landing descent to the surface of Earth, Van looks down on its cluttered surface and begins listing off places he recognizes. James joins in by bringing up the history of the cities you fly over, and the two of them begin making jokes about the worst places to live on <planet>.
units.italian: Mentre fai l'ultima discesa verso la superficie della Terra, Van guarda in basso la sua superficie affollata e comincia a elencare i posti che riconosce. James si unisce raccontando la storia delle città che sorvolate, e i due cominciano a fare battute sui peggiori posti in cui vivere su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	As he steps off, Van hands you <payment>. "Thanks for the fun times, but I'd best be going. I've got work first thing in the morning."|1125|0
units.english: As he steps off, Van hands you <payment>. "Thanks for the fun times, but I'd best be going. I've got work first thing in the morning."
units.italian: Mentre scende, Van ti consegna <payment>. "Grazie delle belle ore, ma è meglio che vada. Ho il lavoro di prima mattina."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	After he leaves, James says, "I haven't met too many people from Earth during my time. Even today, billions of people grow up and die on this planet without taking a single step on another world." Then, he picks up his luggage and adds, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."|1126|0
units.english: After he leaves, James says, "I haven't met too many people from Earth during my time. Even today, billions of people grow up and die on this planet without taking a single step on another world." Then, he picks up his luggage and adds, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Dopo che se n'è andato, James dice: "Non ho conosciuto molte persone della Terra ai miei tempi. Ancora oggi miliardi di persone nascono e muoiono su questo pianeta senza mettere mai piede su un altro mondo." Poi prende i bagagli e aggiunge: "Stesso accordo di prima. Se vuoi continuare a viaggiare insieme, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

One of the most prominent manufacturers of starship outfits, Deep Sky, is headquartered on <origin>. Usually, they use a company fleet to deliver their equipment to other outfitters. However, a pirate attack has left that fleet out of commission, so they're asking merchants to assist where possible. Are you willing to help out?"
units.italian: Trovi James che parla con un uomo in abito da ufficio. "Capitano <last>!" dice James. "Contento che tu sia qui. Uno dei più importanti produttori di equipaggiamenti per navi stellari, la Deep Sky, ha la sede principale su <origin>. Di solito usano una flotta aziendale per consegnare le loro attrezzature agli altri fornitori. Però un attacco pirata ha messo fuori uso quella flotta, quindi chiedono ai mercanti di dare una mano dove possibile. Sei disposto ad aiutare?"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Freighter]|	"I'll help."|1176|0
units.english: "I'll help."
units.italian: "Aiuto io."
