units.italian: Il paesaggio di <origin> supera persino le distese urbane di Midgard e Asgard. Oltre le pareti di vetro dello spazioporto si stende una vasta foresta di grattacieli che arriva al limite del tuo campo visivo. In lontananza le luci degli edifici si fondono, come se l'orizzonte andasse a fuoco.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Freighter]|	James sees you from a distance and waves you over. As you walk over, you are treated to the overwhelming smell of raw fish, sticking out like a sore thumb in the industrial environment. "I've found another job for you," he says.|1204|0
units.english: James sees you from a distance and waves you over. As you walk over, you are treated to the overwhelming smell of raw fish, sticking out like a sore thumb in the industrial environment. "I've found another job for you," he says.
units.italian: James ti vede da lontano e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti. Mentre ti avvicini vieni investito dall'odore travolgente di pesce crudo, che spicca come un pugno in un occhio nell'ambiente industriale. "Ho trovato un altro lavoro per te," dice.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Is it by any chance an unusually smelly job?"|1206|0
units.english: "Is it by any chance an unusually smelly job?"
units.italian: "È per caso un lavoro insolitamente puzzolente?"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Sorry, I think I'll head off on my own now."|1207|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think I'll head off on my own now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che ora andrò per conto mio."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Freighter]|	"It is indeed," he says, "but a lucrative one. <cargo> needs to get to <planet> while it's still fresh, and that means it needs to be there no later than <day>. If we take a direct route, there should be no trouble making the delivery on time. What do you say?"|1209|0
units.english: "It is indeed," he says, "but a lucrative one. <cargo> needs to get to <planet> while it's still fresh, and that means it needs to be there no later than <day>. If we take a direct route, there should be no trouble making the delivery on time. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Lo è davvero," dice, "ma è redditizio. <cargo> deve arrivare su <planet> finché è ancora fresco, e questo significa che deve essere là non più tardi del <day>. Se prendiamo una rotta diretta, non dovremmo avere problemi a consegnare in tempo. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Sounds good. Let's do it!"|1211|0
units.english: "Sounds good. Let's do it!"
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene. Facciamolo!"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Freighter]|	"No way am I loading up my shiny new starship with smelly fish. Count me out."|1212|0
units.english: "No way am I loading up my shiny new starship with smelly fish. Count me out."
units.italian: "Non se ne parla di caricare pesce puzzolente sulla mia nave stellare nuova di zecca. Senza di me."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Great!" he says. "I mentioned this earlier, but you might want to stop by the outfitter and buy a local map. Hyperspace routes aren't always logical, and the last thing you want to do is get lost and end up with a pile of rotten fish that no one wants filling up your cargo hold.|1214|0
units.english: "Great!" he says. "I mentioned this earlier, but you might want to stop by the outfitter and buy a local map. Hyperspace routes aren't always logical, and the last thing you want to do is get lost and end up with a pile of rotten fish that no one wants filling up your cargo hold.
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice. "L'ho già detto prima, ma potresti passare dal fornitore e comprare una mappa locale. Le rotte dell'iperspazio non sono sempre logiche, e l'ultima cosa che vuoi è perderti e ritrovarti con un mucchio di pesce marcio che nessuno vuole a riempire la stiva.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Freighter]|	"We're also leaving Deep space soon; pirate attacks are a lot more frequent outside of the Deep or the Paradise Worlds, so watch out."|1215|0
units.english: "We're also leaving Deep space soon; pirate attacks are a lot more frequent outside of the Deep or the Paradise Worlds, so watch out."
units.italian: "E stiamo anche per lasciare lo spazio del Deep; gli attacchi dei pirati sono molto più frequenti fuori dal Deep o dai Mondi Paradisiaci, quindi sta' attento."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Interceptor]|	James lets out a laugh. "Now that's the spirit! units.english: James lets out a laugh. "Now that's the spirit! Most Sparrow pilots get the wind knocked out of them after their first taste of danger, and decide to do some asteroid mining instead. It takes some time to find a system with good enough materials, but the lower risk is worth it. Anyway, I'll see if there's another mission in the spaceport for you. Meet me there."
units.italian: James si lascia andare a una risata. "Così si parla! Molti piloti di Sparrow restano senza fiato dopo il primo assaggio di pericolo e decidono di mettersi a estrarre asteroidi. Ci vuole un po' per trovare un sistema con materiali abbastanza buoni, ma il rischio minore vale la pena. Comunque, vedrò se c'è un'altra missione allo spazioporto per te. Raggiungimi là."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"That's just how it is," James says. "Don't forget you're in a <model>; the very bottom of the food chain. You've got to respect any and all opponents, no matter how weak you think they are. Some Sparrow pilots realize how vulnerable their ship is, and decide to take up asteroid mining instead. It takes some time to find a system with good enough materials, but the lower risk is worth it. Anyway, meet me in the spaceport if you want to do another job."|1291|0
units.english: "That's just how it is," James says. "Don't forget you're in a <model>; the very bottom of the food chain. You've got to respect any and all opponents, no matter how weak you think they are. Some Sparrow pilots realize how vulnerable their ship is, and decide to take up asteroid mining instead. It takes some time to find a system with good enough materials, but the lower risk is worth it. Anyway, meet me in the spaceport if you want to do another job."
units.italian: "È così che va," dice James. "Non dimenticare che sei su una <model>: il fondo della catena alimentare. Devi rispettare ogni avversario, per quanto debole tu lo creda. Alcuni piloti di Sparrow capiscono quanto sia vulnerabile la loro nave e decidono di mettersi a estrarre asteroidi. Ci vuole un po' per trovare un sistema con materiali abbastanza buoni, ma il rischio minore vale la pena. Comunque, raggiungimi allo spazioporto se vuoi fare un altro lavoro."

units.italian: Scorta un convoglio mercantile fino a <destination>, insieme a James.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Interceptor]|blocked|1302|0
units.english: When you meet up with James in the spaceport, he says, "Hi there, <first>! I found you another mission, but it looks like you'll need <capacity> in order to take it on. So, you'll either have to cancel another mission, or come back here later to continue this one. Sorry!"
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ti ho trovato un'altra missione, ma a quanto pare ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Interceptor]|The landscape of <origin> beats even the urban sprawls of Midgard and Asgard. Beyond the spaceport's glass walls is a vast forest of skyscrapers reaching out to the edge of your vision. Far away, the lights of distant buildings blend together, as though the horizon is ablaze.|1326|0
units.english: The landscape of <origin> beats even the urban sprawls of Midgard and Asgard. Beyond the spaceport's glass walls is a vast forest of skyscrapers reaching out to the edge of your vision. Far away, the lights of distant buildings blend together, as though the horizon is ablaze.
units.italian: Il paesaggio di <origin> supera persino le distese urbane di Midgard e Asgard. Oltre le pareti di vetro dello spazioporto si stende una vasta foresta di grattacieli che arriva al limite del tuo campo visivo. In lontananza le luci degli edifici si fondono, come se l'orizzonte andasse a fuoco.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Interceptor]|	You find James standing on a landing pad underneath a large freighter, chatting with a person you assume is the captain. "There you are!" he says. "Captain McLain here says their two ships have always had troubles with pirates when venturing outside of the Deep, and they're looking for an escort to get them safely to Gemstone. Are you interested?"|1327|0
units.english: You find James standing on a landing pad underneath a large freighter, chatting with a person you assume is the captain. "There you are!" he says. "Captain McLain here says their two ships have always had troubles with pirates when venturing outside of the Deep, and they're looking for an escort to get them safely to Gemstone. Are you interested?"
units.italian: Trovi James in piedi su una piazzola sotto un grande mercantile, che chiacchiera con una persona che supponi sia il capitano. "Eccoti!" dice. "Il capitano McLain qui dice che le loro due navi hanno sempre problemi con i pirati quando si avventurano fuori dal Deep, e cercano una scorta per portarle sane e salve su Gemstone. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Interceptor]|	"Of course!"|1329|0
units.english: "Of course!"
units.italian: "Certamente!"

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Interceptor]|	"No, sounds a bit too risky for me."|1330|0
units.english: "No, sounds a bit too risky for me."
units.italian: "No, mi sembra troppo rischioso per me."

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Interceptor]|	"Great," he says. "Whenever we're ready to leave the planet, they'll take off behind us and follow us to <planet>." As you begin walking away together, he adds in a quieter voice, "While the Deep is well guarded against pirates, most of human space is clamoring with bandits and other ruffians. Normally a fresh pilot like you with no combat reputation would never be offered a mission like this, so try not to mess things up. Remember that we don't have to kill the pirates, all we have to do is make sure the convoy isn't destroyed. But freighters are slow, so you can't just go skipping through hyperspace as fast as you want; you need to stick around and make sure they're behind you.|1332|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "Whenever we're ready to leave the planet, they'll take off behind us and follow us to <planet>." As you begin walking away together, he adds in a quieter voice, "While the Deep is well guarded against pirates, most of human space is clamoring with bandits and other ruffians. Normally a fresh pilot like you with no combat reputation would never be offered a mission like this, so try not to mess things up. Remember that we don't have to kill the pirates, all we have to do is make sure the convoy isn't destroyed. But freighters are slow, so you can't just go skipping through hyperspace as fast as you want; you need to stick around and make sure they're behind you.
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Quando saremo pronti a lasciare il pianeta, decolleranno dietro di noi e ci seguiranno fino a <planet>." Mentre vi allontanate insieme, aggiunge a voce più bassa: "Il Deep è ben guardato dai pirati, ma la maggior parte dello spazio umano brulica di banditi e altri gaglioffi. Normalmente a un pilota fresco come te, senza reputazione in combattimento, non verrebbe mai offerta una missione così, quindi cerca di non combinare pasticci. Ricorda che non dobbiamo uccidere i pirati: dobbiamo solo assicurarci che il convoglio non venga distrutto. Ma i mercantili sono lenti, quindi non puoi saltare per l'iperspazio come ti pare e piace: devi restare nei paraggi e assicurarti che siano dietro di te.

units.id: mission:Midgard Intro [2 Interceptor]|	"Also, make sure to refuel your ship in Zosma before jumping into Algieba; if you run out of fuel there, you'll be a sitting duck unless you can get another ship to help you."|1333|0
units.english: "Also, make sure to refuel your ship in Zosma before jumping into Algieba; if you run out of fuel there, you'll be a sitting duck unless you can get another ship to help you."
units.italian: "Inoltre, rifornisci la nave su Zosma prima di saltare in Algieba; se resti senza carburante là, sarai un bersaglio fermo a meno che non riesca a farti aiutare da un'altra nave."

units.italian: Sei arrivato su <destination>, ma non hai almeno cinque tonnellate di silicio nella stiva. Trova ed estrai asteroidi di silicio in questo sistema prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport]|The world of <origin> is in full bloom; the gardens the spaceport overlooks are filled with a spectrum of flowers, and a sweet smell rests in the air. Eventually you find James with a small group in tow: four young-looking men and women.|1444|0
units.english: The world of <origin> is in full bloom; the gardens the spaceport overlooks are filled with a spectrum of flowers, and a sweet smell rests in the air. Eventually you find James with a small group in tow: four young-looking men and women.
units.italian: Il mondo di <origin> è in pieno fiore: i giardini che lo spazioporto domina sono pieni di uno spettro di fiori, e nell'aria resta un profumo dolce. Alla fine trovi James con un piccolo gruppo al seguito: quattro uomini e donne dall'aria giovane.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport]|	"Captain <last>!" he says. "Wonderful to see you again. I was just talking to this group of engineers. Their original transport has been delayed, and they're looking for another ship to take them to <planet>. They can pay you <payment> to take them there. What do you say?"|1445|0
units.english: "Captain <last>!" he says. "Wonderful to see you again. I was just talking to this group of engineers. Their original transport has been delayed, and they're looking for another ship to take them to <planet>. They can pay you <payment> to take them there. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Capitano <last>!" dice. "Che bello rivederti. Stavo proprio parlando con questo gruppo di ingegneri. Il loro trasporto originale è in ritardo e cercano un'altra nave che li porti su <planet>. Possono pagarti <payment> per portarli là. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport]|	"Welcome aboard!"|1447|0
units.english: "Welcome aboard!"
units.italian: "Benvenuti a bordo!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport]|	"Sorry, I think I'd rather go off in my own direction from here."|1448|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think I'd rather go off in my own direction from here."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che preferirei andare per la mia direzione da qui."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport]|	You and James direct the team to your ship. Looks like you're about to set off on your first real job...|1450|0
units.english: You and James direct the team to your ship. Looks like you're about to set off on your first real job...
units.italian: Tu e James indirizzate la squadra verso la tua nave. Sembra che tu stia per partire per il tuo primo lavoro serio...

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport]|Along the journey, you learned that the team of engineers you are transporting are working on replacing one of their automated terraforming controllers. "We all graduated from the same class on Chiron," one of the engineers says while grinning. "One of us managed to land a job on Glory thanks to a relative, and from there, we were able to form our team. There's been ups and downs over the last few decades, but we always managed to figure things out in the end." He looks barely a day over twenty-five.|1456|0
units.english: Along the journey, you learned that the team of engineers you are transporting are working on replacing one of their automated terraforming controllers. "We all graduated from the same class on Chiron," one of the engineers says while grinning. "One of us managed to land a job on Glory thanks to a relative, and from there, we were able to form our team. There's been ups and downs over the last few decades, but we always managed to figure things out in the end." He looks barely a day over twenty-five.
units.italian: Lungo il viaggio scopri che la squadra di ingegneri che stai trasportando lavora alla sostituzione di uno dei loro controllori automatici per la terraformazione. "Ci siamo laureati tutti nella stessa classe su Chiron," dice uno degli ingegneri con un sorriso. "Uno di noi è riuscito a trovare lavoro su Glory grazie a un parente, e da lì abbiamo potuto formare la nostra squadra. Ci sono stati alti e bassi negli ultimi decenni, ma alla fine siamo sempre riusciti a risolvere." Dimostra a malapena venticinque anni.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport]|	You say goodbye to them and wish them well, and as agreed they pay you <payment>. You have just completed your first proper job as a starship captain!|1457|0
units.english: You say goodbye to them and wish them well, and as agreed they pay you <payment>. You have just completed your first proper job as a starship captain!
units.italian: Li saluti e auguri loro ogni bene, e come concordato ti pagano <payment>. Hai appena completato il tuo primo lavoro serio come capitano di nave stellare!

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport]|	As James leaves the ship, he says, "Again, if you're okay with continuing to give me a ride, just meet me in the spaceport."|1458|0
units.english: As James leaves the ship, he says, "Again, if you're okay with continuing to give me a ride, just meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Mentre James lascia la nave, dice: "Di nuovo: se ti va di continuare a darmi un passaggio, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport]|	(As before, click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)|1460|0
units.english: (As before, click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)
units.italian: (Come prima, per continuare questa missione premi il pulsante "Spazioporto".)

units.italian: Turisti per <planet>

units.english: It is raining.
units.italian: Sta piovendo.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport]|	A deep fog envelops the spaceport city on <origin>. In the distance, you can see the faded lights of distant starships drifting like phantoms. On the streets below, harsh rain whips against the congested traffic, blurring it into a muddy mess of red light.|1478|0
units.english: A deep fog envelops the spaceport city on <origin>. In the distance, you can see the faded lights of distant starships drifting like phantoms. On the streets below, harsh rain whips against the congested traffic, blurring it into a muddy mess of red light.
units.italian: Una nebbia fitta avvolge la città-spazioporto su <origin>. In lontananza vedi le luci sbiadite di navi stellari lontane che vanno alla deriva come fantasmi. Nelle strade sottostanti una pioggia aspra sferza il traffico congestionato, sfumandolo in una poltiglia fangosa di luce rossa.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport]|	By the time you see James, he's already got a small group of people with him: a young couple, and a teenage boy. "Hi there, Captain <last>!" says James. "Interested in carrying some tourists to <planet>?"|1479|0
units.english: By the time you see James, he's already got a small group of people with him: a young couple, and a teenage boy. "Hi there, Captain <last>!" says James. "Interested in carrying some tourists to <planet>?"
units.italian: Quando vedi James, ha già con sé un piccolo gruppo: una giovane coppia e un ragazzo adolescente. "Buongiorno, Capitano <last>!" dice James. "Ti va di portare qualche turista su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport]|	"Sure!"|1481|0
units.english: "Sure!"
units.italian: "Certo!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport]|	"No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."|1482|0
units.english: "No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."
units.italian: "No grazie, credo che ora andrò per conto mio."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport]|	"Great," he says. "This is Chiyo, Salim, and their son Khalil. Let's help them carry their luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of them, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time."|1484|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "This is Chiyo, Salim, and their son Khalil. Let's help them carry their luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of them, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Loro sono Chiyo, Salim e loro figlio Khalil. Aiutiamoli a portare i bagagli alla tua nave." Mentre tornate indietro, tu leggermente davanti a loro, James ti sussurra: "I turisti sono sempre un buon modo di fare soldi. Sono in vacanza, quindi non dispiacciono a pagare un po' di più. Ma non ha senso sprecare spazio in stiva, quindi dai un'occhiata alla bacheca degli incarichi e vedi se ci sono consegne da fare nello stesso viaggio."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport]|As you make the final landing descent to the surface of Earth, Chiyo and Salim stare out the window in rapt attention, pointing out landmarks on the planet's surface. James joins in by telling you all about some of the history of the cities you are flying over. Khalil, meanwhile, has spent the entire journey playing a video game, and only glances out the window when the ship shakes from turbulence. As they all grab their luggage and step off your ship to explore humanity's homeworld, he is still immersed in the game.|1490|0
units.english: As you make the final landing descent to the surface of Earth, Chiyo and Salim stare out the window in rapt attention, pointing out landmarks on the planet's surface. James joins in by telling you all about some of the history of the cities you are flying over. Khalil, meanwhile, has spent the entire journey playing a video game, and only glances out the window when the ship shakes from turbulence. As they all grab their luggage and step off your ship to explore humanity's homeworld, he is still immersed in the game.
units.italian: Mentre fai l'ultima discesa verso la superficie della Terra, Chiyo e Salim fissano il finestrino con attenzione rapita, indicando i punti di riferimento sulla superficie del pianeta. James si unisce raccontandoti un po' della storia delle città che stai sorvolando. Khalil, invece, ha passato tutto il viaggio a giocare a un videogioco e guarda fuori dal finestrino solo quando la nave trema per la turbolenza. Mentre prendono i bagagli e scendono dalla nave per esplorare il mondo natale dell'umanità, è ancora immerso nel gioco.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport]|	As you collect your payment, James pulls the parents aside and says, "Watch out for pickpockets, okay? And take it from an experienced captain, you do not want to be out after dark here. Play it safe, and have a great time."|1491|0
units.english: As you collect your payment, James pulls the parents aside and says, "Watch out for pickpockets, okay? And take it from an experienced captain, you do not want to be out after dark here. Play it safe, and have a great time."
units.italian: Mentre incassi il pagamento, James prende da parte i genitori e dice: "Attenti ai borsaioli, intesi? E credetemi, da capitano esperto: non volete restare fuori dopo il buio, qui. Andate sul sicuro e divertitevi."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport]|	After they leave, James shakes his head ruefully. "It'll probably be a decade before that kid is old enough to realize what he's missing out on. Waste of money, doing a trip like this with a teenage boy. They should've gone to Vinci and visited the holo-arcades; I'm sure that would interest him a lot more than historical museums and ancient cities." Then, he picks up his luggage and adds, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."|1492|0
units.english: After they leave, James shakes his head ruefully. "It'll probably be a decade before that kid is old enough to realize what he's missing out on. Waste of money, doing a trip like this with a teenage boy. They should've gone to Vinci and visited the holo-arcades; I'm sure that would interest him a lot more than historical museums and ancient cities." Then, he picks up his luggage and adds, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Dopo che se ne sono andati, James scuote la testa con amarezza. "Passerà probabilmente un decennio prima che quel ragazzo sia abbastanza grande da capire cosa si sta perdendo. Un viaggio così con un adolescente è denaro buttato. Sarebbero dovuti andare su Vinci a visitare le sale olografiche; sono sicuro che lo interesserebbe molto più dei musei storici e delle città antiche." Poi prende i bagagli e aggiunge: "Stesso accordo di prima. Se vuoi continuare a viaggiare insieme, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ti ho trovato un'altra missione, ma a quanto pare ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport Alt]|The world of <origin> is in full bloom; the gardens the spaceport overlooks are filled with a spectrum of flowers, and a sweet smell rests in the air. Eventually you find James, with someone else in tow.|1542|0
units.english: The world of <origin> is in full bloom; the gardens the spaceport overlooks are filled with a spectrum of flowers, and a sweet smell rests in the air. Eventually you find James, with someone else in tow.
units.italian: Il mondo di <origin> è in pieno fiore: i giardini che lo spazioporto domina sono pieni di uno spettro di fiori, e nell'aria resta un profumo dolce. Alla fine trovi James, con qualcun altro al seguito.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport Alt]|	"Captain <last>!" he says. "Wonderful to see you again. I was just talking to Jan over here. His original transport has been delayed, and he's looking for another ship to take him to <planet>. He can pay you <payment> to take him there. What do you say?"|1543|0
units.english: "Captain <last>!" he says. "Wonderful to see you again. I was just talking to Jan over here. His original transport has been delayed, and he's looking for another ship to take him to <planet>. He can pay you <payment> to take him there. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Capitano <last>!" dice. "Che bello rivederti. Stavo proprio parlando con Jan, qui. Il suo trasporto originale è in ritardo e cerca un'altra nave che lo porti su <planet>. Può pagarti <payment> per portarlo là. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport Alt]|	"Welcome aboard!"|1545|0
units.english: "Welcome aboard!"
units.italian: "Benvenuto a bordo!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport Alt]|	"Sorry, I think I'd rather go off in my own direction from here."|1546|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think I'd rather go off in my own direction from here."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che preferirei andare per la mia direzione da qui."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport Alt]|	You and James direct Jan to your ship. Looks like you're about to set off on your first real job...|1548|0
units.english: You and James direct Jan to your ship. Looks like you're about to set off on your first real job...
units.italian: Tu e James indirizzate Jan verso la tua nave. Sembra che tu stia per partire per il tuo primo lavoro serio...

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport Alt]|Along the journey, you learned that Jan is a terraforming engineer traveling to <planet> to meet with his colleagues. "We all graduated from the same class on Chiron," he says. "One of us managed to land a job on Glory thanks to a relative, and from there, we were able to form our team. There's been ups and downs across our decades of work, but we always managed to figure things out in the end." He looks barely a day over twenty-five.|1554|0
units.english: Along the journey, you learned that Jan is a terraforming engineer traveling to <planet> to meet with his colleagues. "We all graduated from the same class on Chiron," he says. "One of us managed to land a job on Glory thanks to a relative, and from there, we were able to form our team. There's been ups and downs across our decades of work, but we always managed to figure things out in the end." He looks barely a day over twenty-five.
units.italian: Lungo il viaggio scopri che Jan è un ingegnere della terraformazione in viaggio verso <planet> per incontrare i suoi colleghi. "Ci siamo laureati tutti nella stessa classe su Chiron," dice. "Uno di noi è riuscito a trovare lavoro su Glory grazie a un parente, e da lì abbiamo potuto formare la nostra squadra. Ci sono stati alti e bassi nei nostri decenni di lavoro, ma alla fine siamo sempre riusciti a risolvere." Dimostra a malapena venticinque anni.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport Alt]|	You say goodbye to Jan and wish him well, and as agreed he pays you <payment>. You have just completed your first proper job as a starship captain!|1555|0
units.english: You say goodbye to Jan and wish him well, and as agreed he pays you <payment>. You have just completed your first proper job as a starship captain!
units.italian: Saluti Jan e gli auguri ogni bene, e come concordato ti paga <payment>. Hai appena completato il tuo primo lavoro serio come capitano di nave stellare!

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport Alt]|	As James leaves the ship, he says, "Again, if you're okay with continuing to give me a ride, just meet me in the spaceport."|1556|0
units.english: As James leaves the ship, he says, "Again, if you're okay with continuing to give me a ride, just meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Mentre James lascia la nave, dice: "Di nuovo: se ti va di continuare a darmi un passaggio, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Transport Alt]|	(As before, click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)|1558|0
units.english: (As before, click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)
units.italian: (Come prima, per continuare questa missione premi il pulsante "Spazioporto".)

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|name|1564|0
units.english: Tourist to <planet>
units.italian: Turista per <planet>

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|description|1565|0
units.english: This tourist will pay you <payment> to take him to <destination>. Your new friend James will also be tagging along for the ride.
units.italian: Questo turista ti pagherà <payment> per portarlo su <destination>. Anche il tuo nuovo amico James verrà con voi.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|blocked|1566|0
units.english: When you meet up with James in the spaceport, he says, "Hi there, <first>! I found you another mission, but it looks like you'll need <capacity> in order to take it on. So, you'll either have to cancel another mission, or come back here later to continue this one. Sorry!"
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ti ho trovato un'altra missione, ma a quanto pare ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|It is raining.|1575|0
units.english: It is raining.
units.italian: Sta piovendo.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	A deep fog envelops the spaceport city on <origin>. In the distance, you can see the faded lights of distant starships drifting like phantoms. On the streets below, harsh rain whips against the congested traffic, blurring it into a muddy mess of red light.|1576|0
units.english: A deep fog envelops the spaceport city on <origin>. In the distance, you can see the faded lights of distant starships drifting like phantoms. On the streets below, harsh rain whips against the congested traffic, blurring it into a muddy mess of red light.
units.italian: Una nebbia fitta avvolge la città-spazioporto su <origin>. In lontananza vedi le luci sbiadite di navi stellari lontane che vanno alla deriva come fantasmi. Nelle strade sottostanti una pioggia aspra sferza il traffico congestionato, sfumandolo in una poltiglia fangosa di luce rossa.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	"Hi there, Captain <last>!" James says as he approaches you. "Interested in carrying a tourist to <planet>?" Behind him is a young-looking man wearing a floral shirt.|1577|0
units.english: "Hi there, Captain <last>!" James says as he approaches you. "Interested in carrying a tourist to <planet>?" Behind him is a young-looking man wearing a floral shirt.
units.italian: "Buongiorno, Capitano <last>!" dice James avvicinandosi. "Ti va di portare un turista su <planet>?" Dietro di lui c'è un uomo dall'aria giovane con una camicia a fiori.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	"Sure!"|1579|0
units.english: "Sure!"
units.italian: "Certo!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	"No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."|1580|0
units.english: "No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."
units.italian: "No grazie, credo che ora andrò per conto mio."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	"Great," he says. "This is Mecit. Let's help him carry his luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of him, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money, especially if you're low on bunk space. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time."|1582|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "This is Mecit. Let's help him carry his luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of him, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money, especially if you're low on bunk space. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Lui è Mecit. Aiutiamolo a portare i bagagli alla tua nave." Mentre tornate indietro, tu leggermente davanti a lui, James ti sussurra: "I turisti sono sempre un buon modo di fare soldi, soprattutto se hai poco spazio per i posti letto. Sono in vacanza, quindi non dispiacciono a pagare un po' di più. Ma non ha senso sprecare spazio in stiva, quindi dai un'occhiata alla bacheca degli incarichi e vedi se ci sono consegne da fare nello stesso viaggio."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|As you make the final landing descent to the surface of Earth, Mecit looks down on Earth's cluttered surface, his eyes wide open. In an attempt to lighten the mood, James begins telling the both of you some of the history of the cities you are flying over, but Mecit wears a dour expression on his face up until he picks up his luggage and prepares to disembark.|1588|0
units.english: As you make the final landing descent to the surface of Earth, Mecit looks down on Earth's cluttered surface, his eyes wide open. In an attempt to lighten the mood, James begins telling the both of you some of the history of the cities you are flying over, but Mecit wears a dour expression on his face up until he picks up his luggage and prepares to disembark.
units.italian: Mentre fai l'ultima discesa verso la superficie della Terra, Mecit guarda in basso la superficie affollata del pianeta, con gli occhi sgranati. Nel tentativo di alleggerire l'atmosfera, James comincia a raccontarvi un po' della storia delle città che sorvolate, ma Mecit mantiene un'espressione cupa finché non prende i bagagli e si prepara a scendere.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	As you collect your payment, James pulls Mecit aside and says, "Watch out for pickpockets, okay? And take it from an experienced captain, you do not want to be out after dark here. Play it safe, and have a great time."|1589|0
units.english: As you collect your payment, James pulls Mecit aside and says, "Watch out for pickpockets, okay? And take it from an experienced captain, you do not want to be out after dark here. Play it safe, and have a great time."
units.italian: Mentre incassi il pagamento, James prende da parte Mecit e dice: "Attenti ai borsaioli, intesi? E credetemi, da capitano esperto: non volete restare fuori dopo il buio, qui. Andate sul sicuro e divertitevi."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Transport Alt]|	After he leaves, James shakes his head ruefully. "He probably expected Earth to be a relaxing holiday planet, like Caldra or Farseer. I just hope that he's able to see past his preconceptions and appreciate <planet>'s legacy." Then, he picks up his luggage and adds, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."|1590|0
units.english: After he leaves, James shakes his head ruefully. "He probably expected Earth to be a relaxing holiday planet, like Caldra or Farseer. I just hope that he's able to see past his preconceptions and appreciate <planet>'s legacy." Then, he picks up his luggage and adds, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Dopo che se n'è andato, James scuote la testa con amarezza. "Probabilmente si aspettava che la Terra fosse un pianeta di vacanza rilassante, tipo Caldra o Farseer. Spero solo che riesca a guardare oltre i suoi pregiudizi e ad apprezzare l'eredità di <planet>." Poi prende i bagagli e aggiunge: "Stesso accordo di prima. Se vuoi continuare a viaggiare insieme, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Transport Alt]|log|1612|0
units.english: Dropped James off on Hestia after running a few missions with him. Met a skydiver and a hapless tourist, and got to visit Earth along the way.
units.italian: Ho lasciato James su Hestia dopo aver fatto qualche missione con lui. Ho conosciuto un paracadutista e un turista sfortunato, e ho avuto modo di visitare la Terra lungo la strada.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Transport Alt]|log|1613|0
units.english: He currently resides on Hestia, having retired from life as a merchant captain.
units.italian: Ora risiede su Hestia, ritiratosi dalla vita di capitano mercantile.

units.italian: Consegna a <planet>

units.english: Travel with your new friend James to <destination>, and deliver <cargo>.
units.italian: Viaggia con il tuo nuovo amico James fino a <destination>, e consegna <cargo>.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Freighter]|The world of <origin> is in full bloom; the fields that the spaceport overlooks are filled with flowers of every color of the rainbow, and a sweet smell rests in the air. You find James talking with a man wearing dusty, rugged clothing, completely unlike the world around him. "Captain <last>!" says James. "Glad you could join us. Raphael here runs a tourism company centered around rock climbing. He's looking to expand his operations to <planet>, but he needs <cargo> delivered there in advance. Are you willing to help out?"|1638|0
units.english: The world of <origin> is in full bloom; the fields that the spaceport overlooks are filled with flowers of every color of the rainbow, and a sweet smell rests in the air. You find James talking with a man wearing dusty, rugged clothing, completely unlike the world around him. "Captain <last>!" says James. "Glad you could join us. Raphael here runs a tourism company centered around rock climbing. He's looking to expand his operations to <planet>, but he needs <cargo> delivered there in advance. Are you willing to help out?"
units.italian: Il mondo di <origin> è in pieno fiore: i campi che lo spazioporto domina sono pieni di fiori di ogni colore dell'arcobaleno, e nell'aria resta un profumo dolce. Trovi James che parla con un uomo in abiti polverosi e robusti, del tutto diversi dal mondo intorno a lui. "Capitano <last>!" dice James. "Contento che tu sia qui. Raphael qui gestisce un'azienda turistica incentrata sull'arrampicata. Vuole espandere l'attività su <planet>, ma deve far arrivare prima <cargo>. Sei disposto ad aiutare?"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Freighter]|	"I'd be glad to help out!"|1640|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help out!"
units.italian: "Sarò felice di dare una mano!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Freighter]|	"Sorry, but I think I'm going to head out on my own."|1641|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I think I'm going to head out on my own."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma credo che andrò per conto mio."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Freighter]|	"Great!" says James. "They'll be loading up your ship shortly."|1643|0
units.english: "Great!" says James. "They'll be loading up your ship shortly."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice James. "Caricheranno la tua nave a breve."

units.italian: Consegna urgente a <planet>

units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ti ho trovato un'altra missione, ma a quanto pare ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Freighter]|As you walk through the spaceport, James sees you from a distance and waves you over. As you approach, you see several people in hazmat suits working behind him. "I've found another job for you," he says.|1668|0
units.english: As you walk through the spaceport, James sees you from a distance and waves you over. As you approach, you see several people in hazmat suits working behind him. "I've found another job for you," he says.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, James ti vede da lontano e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti. Mentre ti avvicini, vedi diverse persone in tute anti-contaminazione che lavorano dietro di lui. "Ho trovato un altro lavoro per te," dice.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Freighter]|	"I hope it isn't related to those workers."|1670|0
units.english: "I hope it isn't related to those workers."
units.italian: "Spero che non abbia a che fare con quegli operai."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Sorry, I think I'll head off on my own now."|1671|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think I'll head off on my own now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che ora andrò per conto mio."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Freighter]|	"As long as you don't do anything stupid," James says, "like open up the cargo yourself, you'll be safe. <cargo> need to get to the refrigeration vaults on <planet> before they decay, and that means they needs to be there no later than <day>. If we take a direct route, there should be no trouble making the delivery on time. What do you say?"|1673|0
units.english: "As long as you don't do anything stupid," James says, "like open up the cargo yourself, you'll be safe. <cargo> need to get to the refrigeration vaults on <planet> before they decay, and that means they needs to be there no later than <day>. If we take a direct route, there should be no trouble making the delivery on time. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Finché non fai qualcosa di stupido," dice James, "come aprire tu il carico, sarai al sicuro. <cargo> deve arrivare alle celle frigorifere su <planet> prima di deteriorarsi, e questo significa che deve essere là non più tardi del <day>. Se prendiamo una rotta diretta, non dovremmo avere problemi a consegnare in tempo. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Sounds good. Let's do it!"|1675|0
units.english: "Sounds good. Let's do it!"
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene. Facciamolo!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Freighter]|	"I'm not loading diseases onto my shiny new starship. Count me out."|1676|0
units.english: "I'm not loading diseases onto my shiny new starship. Count me out."
units.italian: "Non carico malattie sulla mia nave stellare nuova di zecca. Senza di me."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Great!" he says. "I mentioned this earlier, but you might want to stop by the outfitter and buy a local map. Hyperspace routes aren't always logical, and the last thing you want to do is get lost and end up with canisters full of pathogens no one wants filling up your cargo hold."|1678|0
units.english: "Great!" he says. "I mentioned this earlier, but you might want to stop by the outfitter and buy a local map. Hyperspace routes aren't always logical, and the last thing you want to do is get lost and end up with canisters full of pathogens no one wants filling up your cargo hold."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice. "L'ho già detto prima, ma potresti passare dal fornitore e comprare una mappa locale. Le rotte dell'iperspazio non sono sempre logiche, e l'ultima cosa che vuoi è perderti e ritrovarti con bombole piene di agenti patogeni che nessuno vuole a riempire la stiva."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Freighter]|You find James talking with a group of scientists and dock workers, who seem to be old acquaintances of his. As you approach, he says, "Well guys, here comes my ride. I should probably say goodbye." They head back off to do their work. "Even after all my years as a captain," says James, "I still feel uncomfortable every time I land on <origin>. Every day, scientists on this planet work with pathogens capable of wiping out a planet within months. The danger of infection is such that you need a permit just to live here. Can you imagine spending your life on this planet?"|1700|0
units.english: You find James talking with a group of scientists and dock workers, who seem to be old acquaintances of his. As you approach, he says, "Well guys, here comes my ride. I should probably say goodbye." They head back off to do their work. "Even after all my years as a captain," says James, "I still feel uncomfortable every time I land on <origin>. Every day, scientists on this planet work with pathogens capable of wiping out a planet within months. The danger of infection is such that you need a permit just to live here. Can you imagine spending your life on this planet?"
units.italian: Trovi James che parla con un gruppo di scienziati e scaricatori del porto, che sembrano vecchie conoscenze. Mentre ti avvicini dice: "Beh ragazzi, ecco il mio passaggio. Credo che mi convenga salutare." Loro tornano al lavoro. "Anche dopo tutti i miei anni da capitano," dice James, "mi sento a disagio ogni volta che atterro su <origin>. Ogni giorno, su questo pianeta, gli scienziati lavorano con agenti patogeni capaci di spazzare via un pianeta in pochi mesi. Il rischio di infezione è tale che serve un permesso solo per viverci. Riusciresti a immaginare di passare la vita su questo pianeta?"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Freighter]|	"Somebody has to do the dangerous stuff so that the rest of humanity can prosper."|1702|0
units.english: "Somebody has to do the dangerous stuff so that the rest of humanity can prosper."
units.italian: "Qualcuno deve pur fare le cose pericolose perché il resto dell'umanità possa prosperare."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Freighter]|	"It does seem awfully isolated. But some people might enjoy the solitude."|1703|0
units.english: "It does seem awfully isolated. But some people might enjoy the solitude."
units.italian: "Sembra terribilmente isolato. Ma ad alcuni potrebbe piacere la solitudine."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Freighter]|	"I suppose," he says. "Anyway, I think it's time for the last leg of my journey. Do you think you can give me a lift to <planet>? I'll pay you quite well for your services, of course."|1704|0
units.english: "I suppose," he says. "Anyway, I think it's time for the last leg of my journey. Do you think you can give me a lift to <planet>? I'll pay you quite well for your services, of course."
units.italian: "Suppongo di sì," dice. "Comunque, credo che sia tempo per l'ultima tappa del mio viaggio. Pensi di potermi portare su <planet>? Ti pagherò molto bene per i tuoi servizi, naturalmente."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Freighter]|	"I can take you there."|1706|0
units.english: "I can take you there."
units.italian: "Posso portarti là."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Freighter]|	"Sorry, I was thinking of heading in a different direction from here."|1707|0
units.english: "Sorry, I was thinking of heading in a different direction from here."
units.italian: "Spiacente, pensavo di andare in una direzione diversa da qui."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Freighter]|	Once again you walk back to your ship with James. You've heard of <planet> before; one of the Paradise Worlds terraformed from a lifeless ice planet to the largest and most luxurious retirement home in the galaxy. As you look at his utilitarian outfit and modest luggage, something seems off about the idea of James living in such a place.|1709|0
units.english: Once again you walk back to your ship with James. You've heard of <planet> before; one of the Paradise Worlds terraformed from a lifeless ice planet to the largest and most luxurious retirement home in the galaxy. As you look at his utilitarian outfit and modest luggage, something seems off about the idea of James living in such a place.
units.italian: Ancora una volta torni alla nave con James. Hai già sentito parlare di <planet>: uno dei Mondi Paradisiaci, terraformato da un pianeta di ghiaccio senza vita nella casa di riposo più grande e lussuosa della galassia. Guardando il suo abbigliamento utilitario e i bagagli modesti, qualcosa non torna nell'idea di James che vive in un posto simile.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Freighter]|log|1714|0
units.english: Dropped James off on Hestia after running a few missions with him. Still not convinced that my hold isn't a biohazard.
units.italian: Ho lasciato James su Hestia dopo aver fatto qualche missione con lui. Non sono ancora convinto che la mia stiva non sia un rischio biologico.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Freighter]|log|1715|0
units.english: He currently resides on Hestia, having retired from life as a merchant captain.
units.italian: Ora risiede su Hestia, ritiratosi dalla vita di capitano mercantile.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [0.1 Interceptor]|name|1722|0
units.english: Mine asteroids in <system>
units.italian: Estrarre asteroidi in <system>

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [0.1 Interceptor]|description|1723|0
units.english: Go to the <system> system and mine five tons of lead, then land on <planet>.
units.italian: Vai nel sistema <system> ed estrai cinque tonnellate di piombo, poi atterra su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [0.1 Interceptor]|blocked|1724|0
units.english: When you meet up with James in the spaceport, he says, "Hi there, <first>! I think you'll find what I want to show you next very interesting, but you'll need to free up <capacity> first. So, you'll either have to cancel another mission, or come back here later to continue this one. Sorry!"
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Credo che troverai molto interessante quello che voglio mostrarti adesso, ma prima devi liberare <capacity>. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [0.1 Interceptor]|dialog|1749|0
units.english: You've reached <destination>, but you don't have at least five tons of lead in your cargo hold. Locate and mine lead asteroids in this system before returning.
units.italian: Sei arrivato su <destination>, ma non hai almeno cinque tonnellate di piombo nella stiva. Trova ed estrai asteroidi di piombo in questo sistema prima di tornare.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Interceptor]|name|1759|0
units.english: Escort convoy to <planet>
units.italian: Scortare il convoglio a <planet>

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Interceptor]|description|1760|0
units.english: Escort a merchant convoy to <destination>, along with James.
units.italian: Scorta un convoglio mercantile fino a <destination>, insieme a James.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Interceptor]|blocked|1761|0
units.english: When you meet up with James in the spaceport, he says, "Hi there, <first>! I found you another mission, but it looks like you'll need <capacity> in order to take it on. So, you'll either have to cancel another mission, or come back here later to continue this one. Sorry!"
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ti ho trovato un'altra missione, ma a quanto pare ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Interceptor]|<origin>'s spaceport is located on the least biodiverse island on the planet; a necessity, given that contaminants introduced by outsiders pose the greatest threat to <origin>'s wildlife sanctuaries. That has not stopped the port's architects from making it as extravagant as possible. Walking over the bridge between the landing peninsula and the main port, you are greeted by a verdant plaza, filled with some of the more resilient species of exotic life present on <origin>. Directly ahead, in the center of the spaceport, is a giant holographic globe showing the origins of the flora and fauna on each island.|1785|0
units.english: <origin>'s spaceport is located on the least biodiverse island on the planet; a necessity, given that contaminants introduced by outsiders pose the greatest threat to <origin>'s wildlife sanctuaries. That has not stopped the port's architects from making it as extravagant as possible. Walking over the bridge between the landing peninsula and the main port, you are greeted by a verdant plaza, filled with some of the more resilient species of exotic life present on <origin>. Directly ahead, in the center of the spaceport, is a giant holographic globe showing the origins of the flora and fauna on each island.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di <origin> si trova sull'isola meno ricca di biodiversità del pianeta; una necessità, visto che i contaminanti introdotti dagli estranei rappresentano la minaccia maggiore per i santuari naturalistici di <origin>. Questo non ha impedito agli architetti del porto di renderlo il più sfarzoso possibile. Camminando sul ponte fra la penisola di atterraggio e il porto principale, vieni accolto da una piazza verdeggiante, piena di alcune delle specie più resistenti di vita esotica presenti su <origin>. Davanti a te, al centro dello spazioporto, c'è un gigantesco globo olografico che mostra l'origine della flora e della fauna di ogni isola.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Interceptor]|	Before you can get closer, you are knocked aside by several classes of students pouring out of a Star Queen. They seem to be in primary school, excitedly marching behind their teachers while clutching plushies depicting the animals on this planet.|1786|0
units.english: Before you can get closer, you are knocked aside by several classes of students pouring out of a Star Queen. They seem to be in primary school, excitedly marching behind their teachers while clutching plushies depicting the animals on this planet.
units.italian: Prima che tu possa avvicinarti, vieni travolto da diverse classi di studenti che si riversano fuori da uno Star Queen. Sembrano delle elementari, che marciano eccitati dietro i loro insegnanti stringendo peluche che raffigurano gli animali di questo pianeta.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Interceptor]|	You find James standing on a landing pad underneath a large freighter, chatting with a person you assume is the captain. "There you are!" he says. "Captain Donald here says his two ships have always had troubles with pirates when venturing outside of the Deep, and he's looking for an escort to get them safely to <planet>. Are you interested?"|1787|0
units.english: You find James standing on a landing pad underneath a large freighter, chatting with a person you assume is the captain. "There you are!" he says. "Captain Donald here says his two ships have always had troubles with pirates when venturing outside of the Deep, and he's looking for an escort to get them safely to <planet>. Are you interested?"
units.italian: Trovi James in piedi su una piazzola sotto un grande mercantile, che chiacchiera con una persona che supponi sia il capitano. "Eccoti!" dice. "Il capitano Donald qui dice che le sue due navi hanno sempre problemi con i pirati quando si avventurano fuori dal Deep, e cerca una scorta per portarle sane e salve su <planet>. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"Of course!"|1789|0
units.english: "Of course!"
units.italian: "Certamente!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"No, sounds a bit too risky for me."|1790|0
units.english: "No, sounds a bit too risky for me."
units.italian: "No, mi sembra troppo rischioso per me."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"Great," he says. "Whenever we're ready to leave the planet, they'll take off behind us and follow us to <planet>." As you begin walking away together, he adds in a quieter voice, "While the Paradise Worlds are well guarded against pirates, most of human space, especially the far north, is clamoring with bandits and other ruffians. Normally a fresh pilot like you with no combat reputation would never be offered a mission like this, so try not to mess things up.|1792|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "Whenever we're ready to leave the planet, they'll take off behind us and follow us to <planet>." As you begin walking away together, he adds in a quieter voice, "While the Paradise Worlds are well guarded against pirates, most of human space, especially the far north, is clamoring with bandits and other ruffians. Normally a fresh pilot like you with no combat reputation would never be offered a mission like this, so try not to mess things up.
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Quando saremo pronti a lasciare il pianeta, decolleranno dietro di noi e ci seguiranno fino a <planet>." Mentre vi allontanate insieme, aggiunge a voce più bassa: "I Mondi Paradisiaci sono ben guardati dai pirati, ma la maggior parte dello spazio umano, soprattutto nel profondo nord, brulica di banditi e altri gaglioffi. Normalmente a un pilota fresco come te, senza reputazione in combattimento, non verrebbe mai offerta una missione così, quindi cerca di non combinare pasticci.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"Remember that we don't have to kill the pirates, all we have to do is make sure the convoy isn't destroyed. But freighters are slow, so you can't just go skipping through hyperspace as fast as you want; you need to stick around and make sure they're behind you."|1793|0
units.english: "Remember that we don't have to kill the pirates, all we have to do is make sure the convoy isn't destroyed. But freighters are slow, so you can't just go skipping through hyperspace as fast as you want; you need to stick around and make sure they're behind you."
units.italian: "Ricorda che non dobbiamo uccidere i pirati: dobbiamo solo assicurarci che il convoglio non venga distrutto. Ma i mercantili sono lenti, quindi non puoi saltare per l'iperspazio come ti pare e piace: devi restare nei paraggi e assicurarti che siano dietro di te."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Interceptor]|name|1804|0
units.english: Transport to <planet>
units.italian: Trasporto per <planet>

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Interceptor]|description|1805|0
units.english: Transport an informant, along with James, to <destination>, while avoiding a pirate warship.
units.italian: Trasporta un informatore, insieme a James, su <destination>, evitando una nave da guerra pirata.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Interceptor]|blocked|1806|0
units.english: When you meet up with James in the spaceport, he says, "Hi there, <first>! I found you another mission, but it looks like you'll need <capacity> in order to take it on. So, you'll either have to cancel another mission, or come back here later to continue this one. Sorry!"
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ti ho trovato un'altra missione, ma a quanto pare ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Interceptor]|As you touch down on <planet>, a team of Navy troopers are ready to escort the informant, who has diligently hidden their appearance in a brown cloak for the entire trip, out of your ship. One of the officers hands you a credit chip worth <payment> before turning back to command their squad. From behind, James says, "Well, you made it in one piece! Still think you want to be piloting an interceptor?"|1827|0
units.english: As you touch down on <planet>, a team of Navy troopers are ready to escort the informant, who has diligently hidden their appearance in a brown cloak for the entire trip, out of your ship. One of the officers hands you a credit chip worth <payment> before turning back to command their squad. From behind, James says, "Well, you made it in one piece! Still think you want to be piloting an interceptor?"
units.italian: Mentre ti posi su <planet>, una squadra di soldati della Marina è pronta a scortare l'informatore fuori dalla nave; per tutto il viaggio si è nascosto con diligenza sotto un mantello marrone. Uno degli ufficiali ti consegna un chip di credito da <payment> prima di tornare al comando della squadra. Da dietro, James dice: "Beh, sei arrivato tutto intero! Pensi ancora di voler pilotare un intercettore?"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Interceptor]|	"Sure, but I can't wait until I've got a ship big enough to stand up to pirates instead of running from them."|1829|0
units.english: "Sure, but I can't wait until I've got a ship big enough to stand up to pirates instead of running from them."
units.italian: "Certo, ma non vedo l'ora di avere una nave abbastanza grande da affrontare i pirati invece di scappare."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Interceptor]|	"Well, maybe I should've bought a freighter instead."|1830|0
units.english: "Well, maybe I should've bought a freighter instead."
units.italian: "Beh, forse avrei dovuto comprare un mercantile."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Interceptor]|	"Better start saving up then," he says. "Remember that you can always make a living as an asteroid miner, if the interceptor life proves too much for you.|1831|0
units.english: "Better start saving up then," he says. "Remember that you can always make a living as an asteroid miner, if the interceptor life proves too much for you.
units.italian: "Meglio che inizi a mettere da parte," dice. "Ricorda che puoi sempre guadagnarti da vivere estraendo asteroidi, se la vita da intercettore si rivela troppo per te.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [2 Interceptor]|	"If you're willing to take me on one more journey," James says, "meet me in the spaceport bar in a little while.|1832|0
units.english: "If you're willing to take me on one more journey," James says, "meet me in the spaceport bar in a little while.
units.italian: "Se sei disposto a portarmi in un altro viaggio," dice James, "raggiungimi al bar dello spazioporto fra un po'.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|name|1838|0
units.english: Bring James to <planet>
units.italian: Portare James su <planet>

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|description|1839|0
units.english: Drop James off on <destination>, where he has a spot reserved in a retirement home.
units.italian: Lascia James su <destination>, dove ha un posto prenotato in una casa di riposo.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|blocked|1840|0
units.english: When you meet up with James in the spaceport, he says, "Hi there, <first>! I have one final mission for you, but you'll need <capacity> in order to take it on. So, you'll either have to cancel another mission, or come back here later to continue this one. Sorry!"
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ho un'ultima missione per te, ma ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|Even though barely more than a week has passed since the last time you were on <origin>, something about the planet feels off. Maybe it's because the spaceport is quieter today. Maybe it's because you've sensed a pattern in the way the trees have been planted and grown that isn't dissimilar to the metal supports of Prime's spaceport. Or maybe it's because the bridge acting as the sole connection between the landing pads and the main port would break just as easily as your own ship against the fire of a pirate warship.|1849|0
units.english: Even though barely more than a week has passed since the last time you were on <origin>, something about the planet feels off. Maybe it's because the spaceport is quieter today. Maybe it's because you've sensed a pattern in the way the trees have been planted and grown that isn't dissimilar to the metal supports of Prime's spaceport. Or maybe it's because the bridge acting as the sole connection between the landing pads and the main port would break just as easily as your own ship against the fire of a pirate warship.
units.italian: Anche se è passata poco più di una settimana dall'ultima volta che sei stato su <origin>, qualcosa in questo pianeta ti sembra storto. Forse perché oggi lo spazioporto è più silenzioso. Forse perché hai notato uno schema nel modo in cui gli alberi sono stati piantati e cresciuti, non dissimile dai supporti metallici dello spazioporto di Prime. O forse perché il ponte che rappresenta l'unico collegamento fra le piazzole e il porto principale si spezzerebbe con la stessa facilità della tua nave sotto il fuoco di una nave da guerra pirata.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|	"Something on your mind?" James asks from behind you.|1850|0
units.english: "Something on your mind?" James asks from behind you.
units.italian: "Qualcosa ti preoccupa?" chiede James da dietro di te.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|	"No, nothing."|1852|0
units.english: "No, nothing."
units.italian: "No, niente."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|	"Is this place really any better than Prime?"|1854|0
units.english: "Is this place really any better than Prime?"
units.italian: "Questo posto è davvero meglio di Prime?"

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|	"Better?" James raises an eyebrow. "I'd be lying if I said one of the largest shipyards in the galaxy was worth less than a glorified petting zoo. There's plenty of people out there who'd agree with me too, and plenty who'd consider my words as nothing short of blasphemy.|1855|0
units.english: "Better?" James raises an eyebrow. "I'd be lying if I said one of the largest shipyards in the galaxy was worth less than a glorified petting zoo. There's plenty of people out there who'd agree with me too, and plenty who'd consider my words as nothing short of blasphemy.
units.italian: "Meglio?" James alza un sopracciglio. "Mentirei se dicessi che uno dei più grandi cantieri navali della galassia vale meno di uno zoo di lusso per coccole. E là fuori c'è un sacco di gente che sarebbe d'accordo con me, e altrettanta che considererebbe le mie parole una bestemmia.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|	"Anyway," says James, "would you be willing to take me on one more journey? It's time for me to head for that retirement home, on <planet>."|1856|0
units.english: "Anyway," says James, "would you be willing to take me on one more journey? It's time for me to head for that retirement home, on <planet>."
units.italian: "Comunque," dice James, "saresti disposto a portarmi in un altro viaggio? È tempo che vada in quella casa di riposo, su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|	"Then," says James, "would you be willing to take me on one more journey? It's time for me to head for that retirement home, on <planet>."|1859|0
units.english: "Then," says James, "would you be willing to take me on one more journey? It's time for me to head for that retirement home, on <planet>."
units.italian: "Allora," dice James, "saresti disposto a portarmi in un altro viaggio? È tempo che vada in quella casa di riposo, su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|	"Of course."|1862|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|	"Sorry, I think I'll go hunt some pirates instead."|1863|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think I'll go hunt some pirates instead."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che andrò a caccia di qualche pirata, invece."

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|	Once again you walk back to your ship with James. You've heard of <planet> before; one of the Paradise Worlds terraformed from a lifeless ice planet to the largest and most luxurious retirement home in the galaxy. units.italian: Ancora una volta torni alla nave con James.
