Guardando il suo abbigliamento utilitario e i bagagli modesti, qualcosa non torna nell'idea di James che vive in un posto simile.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|log|1870|0
units.english: Dropped James off on Hestia after running a few missions with him. Escort duty is a risky business.
units.italian: Ho lasciato James su Hestia dopo aver fatto qualche missione con lui. Il servizio di scorta è un mestiere rischioso.

units.id: mission:Mainsail Intro [3 Interceptor]|log|1871|0
units.english: He currently resides on Hestia, having retired from life as a merchant captain.
units.italian: Ora risiede su Hestia, ritiratosi dalla vita di capitano mercantile.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [0]|name|1879|0
units.english: Passenger to <planet>
units.italian: Passeggero per <planet>

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [0]|description|1880|0
units.english: This old-timer captain offered to ride along with you to <destination>, and to give you some tips along the way.
units.italian: Questo capitano veterano si è offerto di viaggiare con te fino a <destination> e di darti qualche dritta lungo la strada.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [0]|log|1897|0
units.english: Getting some basic instructions on making a living as a merchant from an old captain named James.
units.italian: Ricevo qualche istruzione di base su come guadagnarsi da vivere da mercante da un vecchio capitano di nome James.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [0]|log|1898|0
units.english: A old man who accompanied you on your first few jobs as a starship captain.
units.italian: Un vecchio che mi ha accompagnato nei miei primi lavori come capitano di nave stellare.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|name|1908|0
units.english: Transport family to <planet>
units.italian: Trasportare la famiglia su <planet>

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|description|1909|0
units.english: Bring your new friend James, along with a family, to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>.
units.italian: Porta il tuo nuovo amico James, insieme a una famiglia, su <destination>. Il pagamento sarà <payment>.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|blocked|1910|0
units.english: When you meet up with James in the spaceport, he says, "Hi there, <first>! I found you another mission, but it looks like you'll need <capacity> in order to take it on. So, you'll either have to cancel another mission, or come back here later to continue this one. Sorry!"
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ti ho trovato un'altra missione, ma a quanto pare ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|Every step on <origin> is a struggle. By the time you reach the spaceport cafe, you have just enough energy to slump into a chair with steel legs as thick as its cushions. After you have waited for a few minutes, James comes up. Following him is a family of four: a couple pushing along a pram, with a young child following close behind. While James would be below-average height back on Earth, he easily towers over the Burthen natives.|1926|0
units.english: Every step on <origin> is a struggle. By the time you reach the spaceport cafe, you have just enough energy to slump into a chair with steel legs as thick as its cushions. After you have waited for a few minutes, James comes up. Following him is a family of four: a couple pushing along a pram, with a young child following close behind. While James would be below-average height back on Earth, he easily towers over the Burthen natives.
units.italian: Ogni passo su <origin> è una fatica. Quando raggiungi il caffè dello spazioporto hai appena l'energia per crollare su una sedia con le gambe d'acciaio spesse quanto i cuscini. Dopo qualche minuto di attesa arriva James. Dietro di lui c'è una famiglia di quattro: una coppia che spinge un passeggino, con un bambino piccolo subito dietro. James, che sulla Terra sarebbe sotto la statura media, sovrasta facilmente i nativi di Burthen.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|	"Captain <last>!" he says. "Wonderful to see you again. I was just talking to this family. They've been having trouble finding a single ship that can give them all passage, but I told them that your shuttlecraft has plenty of bunks. They can pay you <payment> to take them to <planet>, which is just a few jumps away from Earth, and is a planet well worth visiting in its own right. What do you say?"|1927|0
units.english: "Captain <last>!" he says. "Wonderful to see you again. I was just talking to this family. They've been having trouble finding a single ship that can give them all passage, but I told them that your shuttlecraft has plenty of bunks. They can pay you <payment> to take them to <planet>, which is just a few jumps away from Earth, and is a planet well worth visiting in its own right. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Capitano <last>!" dice. "Che bello rivederti. Stavo proprio parlando con questa famiglia. Hanno avuto difficoltà a trovare una sola nave che potesse dare passaggio a tutti, ma ho detto loro che la tua navetta ha parecchi posti letto. Possono pagarti <payment> per portarli su <planet>, che è a pochi salti dalla Terra ed è un pianeta che vale la visita di per sé. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|	The husband chimes in. "We were afraid that if we were split across multiple ships, we wouldn't be able to keep an eye on Faiza." He gestures towards the child in the pram. "She hasn't been taking Burthen's gravity well."|1928|0
units.english: The husband chimes in. "We were afraid that if we were split across multiple ships, we wouldn't be able to keep an eye on Faiza." He gestures towards the child in the pram. "She hasn't been taking Burthen's gravity well."
units.italian: Il marito interviene. "Avevamo paura che, se ci avessero divisi su più navi, non saremmo riusciti a tenere d'occhio Faiza." Accenna al bambino nel passeggino. "Non sta reagendo bene alla gravità di Burthen."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|	"Welcome aboard!"|1930|0
units.english: "Welcome aboard!"
units.italian: "Benvenuti a bordo!"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|	"Sorry, I think I'd rather go off in my own direction from here."|1931|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think I'd rather go off in my own direction from here."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che preferirei andare per la mia direzione da qui."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|	You and James direct the family to your ship. Looks like you're about to set off on your first real job...|1933|0
units.english: You and James direct the family to your ship. Looks like you're about to set off on your first real job...
units.italian: Tu e James indirizzate la famiglia verso la tua nave. Sembra che tu stia per partire per il tuo primo lavoro serio...

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|Along the journey, you learned more about the family you are transporting and why they are moving to <planet>. "There's Faiza's condition, of course, but we've always wanted to move offworld since before our first child was born," says the mother, Carlijn. "My husband and I constantly moved between different mining towns as we grew up. We didn't want our children to go through the same thing."|1939|0
units.english: Along the journey, you learned more about the family you are transporting and why they are moving to <planet>. "There's Faiza's condition, of course, but we've always wanted to move offworld since before our first child was born," says the mother, Carlijn. "My husband and I constantly moved between different mining towns as we grew up. We didn't want our children to go through the same thing."
units.italian: Lungo il viaggio scopri di più sulla famiglia che stai trasportando e sul perché si trasferiscono su <planet>. "C'è la condizione di Faiza, naturalmente, ma volevamo trasferirci fuori dal pianeta già da prima che nascesse il nostro primo figlio," dice la madre, Carlijn. "Mio marito e io ci siamo spostati di continuo fra varie città minerarie mentre crescevamo. Non volevamo che i nostri figli passassero la stessa cosa."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|	You say goodbye to them and wish them well, and as agreed they pay you <payment>. You are already well on your way towards paying down your mortgage!|1940|0
units.english: You say goodbye to them and wish them well, and as agreed they pay you <payment>. You are already well on your way towards paying down your mortgage!
units.italian: Li saluti e auguri loro ogni bene, e come concordato ti pagano <payment>. Sei già ben avviato a estinguere il mutuo!

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|	As James leaves the ship, he says, "Again, if you're okay with continuing to give me a ride, just meet me in the spaceport."|1941|0
units.english: As James leaves the ship, he says, "Again, if you're okay with continuing to give me a ride, just meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Mentre James lascia la nave, dice: "Di nuovo: se ti va di continuare a darmi un passaggio, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Transport]|	(As before, click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)|1943|0
units.english: (As before, click the "Spaceport" button to continue this mission.)
units.italian: (Come prima, per continuare questa missione premi il pulsante "Spazioporto".)

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|name|1949|0
units.english: Tourists to <planet>
units.italian: Turisti per <planet>

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|description|1950|0
units.english: These tourists will pay you <payment> to take them to <destination>. Your new friend James will also be tagging along for the ride.
units.italian: Questi turisti ti pagheranno <payment> per portarli su <destination>. Anche il tuo nuovo amico James verrà con voi.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|blocked|1951|0
units.english: When you meet up with James in the spaceport, he says, "Hi there, <first>! I found you another mission, but it looks like you'll need <capacity> in order to take it on. So, you'll either have to cancel another mission, or come back here later to continue this one. Sorry!"
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ti ho trovato un'altra missione, ma a quanto pare ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|It is raining.|1960|0
units.english: It is raining.
units.italian: Sta piovendo.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	A deep fog envelops the spaceport city on <origin>. In the distance, you can see the faded lights of distant starships drifting like phantoms. units.english: A deep fog envelops the spaceport city on <origin>. In the distance, you can see the faded lights of distant starships drifting like phantoms. On the streets below, harsh rain whips against the congested traffic, blurring it into a muddy mess of red light.
units.italian: Una nebbia fitta avvolge la città-spazioporto su <origin>. In lontananza vedi le luci sbiadite di navi stellari lontane che vanno alla deriva come fantasmi. Nelle strade sottostanti una pioggia aspra sferza il traffico congestionato, sfumandolo in una poltiglia fangosa di luce rossa.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	By the time you see James, he's accompanied by three others. "Hi there, Captain <last>!" says James. "Interested in carrying some tourists?"|1962|0
units.english: By the time you see James, he's accompanied by three others. "Hi there, Captain <last>!" says James. "Interested in carrying some tourists?"
units.italian: Quando vedi James, è accompagnato da altre tre persone. "Buongiorno, Capitano <last>!" dice James. "Ti va di portare qualche turista?"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	"Where are you headed?"|1964|0
units.english: "Where are you headed?"
units.italian: "Dove siete diretti?"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	"No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."|1965|0
units.english: "No thanks, I think I'll strike off on my own now."
units.italian: "No grazie, credo che ora andrò per conto mio."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	"To <planet>," one of them eagerly replies.|1967|0
units.english: "To <planet>," one of them eagerly replies.
units.italian: "Su <planet>," risponde con entusiasmo uno di loro.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	"I can take you there."|1969|0
units.english: "I can take you there."
units.italian: "Posso portarvi là."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	"Sorry, but I'd like to avoid <planet> right now."|1970|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'd like to avoid <planet> right now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma preferirei evitare <planet> in questo momento."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	"Great," he says. "This is Chiaki, Sarika, and Catrina. Let's help them carry their luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of them, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time."|1972|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "This is Chiaki, Sarika, and Catrina. Let's help them carry their luggage to your ship." As you begin walking back, slightly ahead of them, James whispers to you, "Tourists are always a good way to make money. They're on vacation, so they don't mind paying a bit extra. But no point in your cargo space going to waste, so take a look at the job board and see if there are any delivery missions we can run at the same time."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Loro sono Chiaki, Sarika e Catrina. Aiutiamole a portare i bagagli alla tua nave." Mentre tornate indietro, tu leggermente davanti a loro, James ti sussurra: "I turisti sono sempre un buon modo di fare soldi. Sono in vacanza, quindi non dispiacciono a pagare un po' di più. Ma non ha senso sprecare spazio in stiva, quindi dai un'occhiata alla bacheca degli incarichi e vedi se ci sono consegne da fare nello stesso viaggio."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|As you make the final landing descent to the surface of Earth, Sarika is on the edge of her seat as she rattles off all the landmarks you pass over, of which you recognize surprisingly few. James tries to show off his own knowledge of the planet's history, but for every story he offers, Sarika responds with five more.|1978|0
units.english: As you make the final landing descent to the surface of Earth, Sarika is on the edge of her seat as she rattles off all the landmarks you pass over, of which you recognize surprisingly few. James tries to show off his own knowledge of the planet's history, but for every story he offers, Sarika responds with five more.
units.italian: Mentre fai l'ultima discesa verso la superficie della Terra, Sarika sta sulla punta della sedia ed elenca di fila tutti i punti di riferimento che sorvolate, dei quali riconosci sorprendentemente pochi. James cerca di sfoggiare la propria conoscenza della storia del pianeta, ma per ogni storia che offre Sarika ne risponde con cinque.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	Catrina lets out a laugh. "Give it a rest, old man. Sarika's been obsessed with the homeworld since she was in diapers." Then, she leans on Chiaki's shoulder. "The real question I wanna ask is why you of all people haven't said a word since re-entry. I mean, isn't seeing Earth again bringing up any memories?"|1979|0
units.english: Catrina lets out a laugh. "Give it a rest, old man. Sarika's been obsessed with the homeworld since she was in diapers." Then, she leans on Chiaki's shoulder. "The real question I wanna ask is why you of all people haven't said a word since re-entry. I mean, isn't seeing Earth again bringing up any memories?"
units.italian: Catrina scoppia a ridere. "Dagli un momento di riposo, vecchio mio. Sarika è ossessionata dal mondo natale da quando era in fasce." Poi si appoggia alla spalla di Chiaki. "La vera domanda che voglio fare è perché proprio tu non hai aperto bocca dal rientro in atmosfera. Voglio dire, rivedere la Terra non ti risveglia nessun ricordo?"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	Chiaki's reply is pointed. "I left this place for a reason." When she sees Catrina's cheeky smile fade, she quickly adds, "It's nothing serious. I'd just prefer making new memories with the two of you than dwelling on the past."|1980|0
units.english: Chiaki's reply is pointed. "I left this place for a reason." When she sees Catrina's cheeky smile fade, she quickly adds, "It's nothing serious. I'd just prefer making new memories with the two of you than dwelling on the past."
units.italian: La risposta di Chiaki è tagliente. "Ho lasciato questo posto per un motivo." Quando vede spegnersi il sorriso sfrontato di Catrina, aggiunge in fretta: "Non è niente di grave. Preferirei solo creare ricordi nuovi con voi due, invece di rimuginare sul passato."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	You carefully follow the instructions from the air traffic controller to a landing pad halfway up the spaceport and bring your ship to rest. After all you've done for the Syndicate to escape this planet, you've returned.|1981|0
units.english: You carefully follow the instructions from the air traffic controller to a landing pad halfway up the spaceport and bring your ship to rest. After all you've done for the Syndicate to escape this planet, you've returned.
units.italian: Segui con attenzione le istruzioni del controllore di volo fino a una piazzola a metà altezza dello spazioporto e posi la nave. Dopo tutto quello che hai fatto per il Sindacato per fuggire da questo pianeta, sei tornato.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	As your passengers disembark and you collect your payment, James pulls the trio aside and says, "Watch out for pickpockets, okay? And take it from an experienced captain, you do not want to be out after dark here. Play it safe, and have a great time."|1982|0
units.english: As your passengers disembark and you collect your payment, James pulls the trio aside and says, "Watch out for pickpockets, okay? And take it from an experienced captain, you do not want to be out after dark here. Play it safe, and have a great time."
units.italian: Mentre i passeggeri scendono e tu incassi il pagamento, James prende da parte il terzetto e dice: "Attenti ai borsaioli, intesi? E credetemi, da capitano esperto: non volete restare fuori dopo il buio, qui. Andate sul sicuro e divertitevi."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Transport]|	After they leave, James chuckles. "Can't say I've ever seen an Earth fanatic and an Earth native in the same group before, let alone be on good terms. That's one of the perks of being a starship captain, though: you get to have the most unique experiences in the galaxy." Then, he picks up his luggage and adds, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."|1983|0
units.english: After they leave, James chuckles. "Can't say I've ever seen an Earth fanatic and an Earth native in the same group before, let alone be on good terms. That's one of the perks of being a starship captain, though: you get to have the most unique experiences in the galaxy." Then, he picks up his luggage and adds, "Same deal as before. If you want to keep traveling together, meet me in the spaceport."
units.italian: Dopo che se ne sono andati, James ridacchia. "Non posso dire di aver mai visto un fanatico della Terra e una nativa della Terra nello stesso gruppo, figuriamoci in buoni rapporti. Ma questo è uno dei vantaggi di fare il capitano di nave stellare: puoi vivere le esperienze più uniche della galassia." Poi prende i bagagli e aggiunge: "Stesso accordo di prima. Se vuoi continuare a viaggiare insieme, raggiungimi allo spazioporto."

units.italian: Portare James su <planet>

units.italian: Quando ti incontri con James allo spazioporto, dice: "Ciao <first>! Ho un'ultima missione per te, ma ti serve <capacity> per prenderla. Quindi o annulli un'altra missione, o torni qui più tardi per continuare questa. Scusa!"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [3 Transport]|<origin> is the same as it's always been. Homeless men wrapped in old army blankets beg money from well-dressed businessmen. Soldiers in Navy uniforms walk by in groups of ten or twenty, driving the beggars to hide behind trashcans or do their best impressions of respectable citizens until they pass. Starship captains haggle with merchants, speaking of sums greater than the income of some neighborhoods. Flashes of light come from various landing bays as poorly-protected welders risk their health to repair ships destined for places they can only dream of.|2000|0
units.english: <origin> is the same as it's always been. Homeless men wrapped in old army blankets beg money from well-dressed businessmen. Soldiers in Navy uniforms walk by in groups of ten or twenty, driving the beggars to hide behind trashcans or do their best impressions of respectable citizens until they pass. Starship captains haggle with merchants, speaking of sums greater than the income of some neighborhoods. Flashes of light come from various landing bays as poorly-protected welders risk their health to repair ships destined for places they can only dream of.
units.italian: <origin> è come è sempre stata. Uomini senza casa avvolti in vecchie coperte militari chiedono soldi a uomini d'affari ben vestiti. Soldati in uniforme della Marina passano in gruppi di dieci o venti, spingendo i mendicanti a nascondersi dietro i bidoni o a fare del loro meglio per sembrare rispettabili cittadini finché non sono passati. Capitani di navi stellari contrattano con i mercanti, parlando di somme superiori al reddito di interi quartieri. Lampade di luce arrivano da varie baie mentre saldatori poco protetti rischiano la salute per riparare navi destinate a luoghi che possono solo sognare.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [3 Transport]|	When you find James, he's standing by a window, looking out at the city, watching the starships taking off and landing in a continuous stream. "You're from Earth, aren't you?" You nod.|2001|0
units.english: When you find James, he's standing by a window, looking out at the city, watching the starships taking off and landing in a continuous stream. "You're from Earth, aren't you?" You nod.
units.italian: Quando trovi James, è in piedi vicino a una finestra, guarda la città e osserva le navi stellari che decollano e atterrano in un flusso continuo. "Tu sei della Terra, vero?" Annuisci.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [3 Transport]|	"Thought so," James replies. "I've seen all manner of reactions to experiencing <origin> in person for the first time. Awe. Surprise. Respect. Disgust. Their second reactions are just as varied. Some take it as a reminder of humanity's ever-present base nature; others see it as an inexcusable failure of the Republic and its predecessors." He smirks. "Only ever seen one kind of reaction from an Earth native. Maybe you folk know something the rest of us don't."|2002|0
units.english: "Thought so," James replies. "I've seen all manner of reactions to experiencing <origin> in person for the first time. Awe. Surprise. Respect. Disgust. Their second reactions are just as varied. Some take it as a reminder of humanity's ever-present base nature; others see it as an inexcusable failure of the Republic and its predecessors." He smirks. "Only ever seen one kind of reaction from an Earth native. Maybe you folk know something the rest of us don't."
units.italian: "Immaginavo," risponde James. "Ho visto ogni genere di reazione a chi vive <origin> di persona per la prima volta. Stupore. Sorpresa. Rispetto. Disgusto. Anche le seconde reazioni sono altrettanto varie. Alcuni la prendono come un monito sulla natura infima sempre presente nell'umanità; altri la vedono come un fallimento imperdonabile della Repubblica e dei suoi predecessori." Sogghigna. "Da un nativo della Terra ho visto solo un tipo di reazione. Forse voi sapete qualcosa che noi altri non sappiamo."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [3 Transport]|	After taking one last look out the window, he says, "Anyway, we're nearing my destination. Are you willing to take me on one last trip? I need to get to <destination>, and of course I'll pay you quite well to take me there."|2003|0
units.english: After taking one last look out the window, he says, "Anyway, we're nearing my destination. Are you willing to take me on one last trip? I need to get to <destination>, and of course I'll pay you quite well to take me there."
units.italian: Dopo un'ultima occhiata fuori dalla finestra, dice: "Comunque, mi avvicino alla mia destinazione. Sei disposto a portarmi in un ultimo viaggio? Devo arrivare su <destination>, e naturalmente ti pagherò molto bene per portarmi là."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [3 Transport]|	"Of course."|2005|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [3 Transport]|	"Sorry, but I was planning on heading out in a different direction from here."|2006|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I was planning on heading out in a different direction from here."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma pensavo di andare in una direzione diversa da qui."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [3 Transport]|	Once again you walk back to your ship with James. Once you get there, as he's stowing his luggage, you pull up the information your computer has on <planet>. It's one of the "Paradise Worlds," terraformed to have a perfect climate, accessible only to the very wealthy. You wonder whether James is going to be able to fit in there.|2008|0
units.english: Once again you walk back to your ship with James. Once you get there, as he's stowing his luggage, you pull up the information your computer has on <planet>. It's one of the "Paradise Worlds," terraformed to have a perfect climate, accessible only to the very wealthy. You wonder whether James is going to be able to fit in there.
units.italian: Ancora una volta torni alla nave con James. Una volta arrivati, mentre lui sistema i bagagli, richiami le informazioni che il computer ha su <planet>. È uno dei "Mondi Paradisiaci", terraformato per avere un clima perfetto, accessibile solo ai molto ricchi. Ti chiedi se James riuscirà a inserirsi là.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [3 Transport]|log|2013|0
units.english: Dropped James off on Hestia after running a few missions with him. Met a few tourists and revisited Earth along the way.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [3 Transport]|log|2014|0
units.english: He currently resides on Hestia, having retired from life as a merchant captain.
units.italian: Ora risiede su Hestia, ritiratosi dalla vita di capitano mercantile.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Freighter]|Every step on <origin> is a struggle. By the time you reach the spaceport cafe, you have just enough energy to slump into a chair with steel legs as thick as its cushions. After taking a rest, you find James talking with a woman who is an offworlder just like you, judging by her height and how labored her movements are. "Captain <last>!" says James. Are you willing to help out? They'll pay for the work, of course."|2038|0
units.english: Every step on <origin> is a struggle. By the time you reach the spaceport cafe, you have just enough energy to slump into a chair with steel legs as thick as its cushions. After taking a rest, you find James talking with a woman who is an offworlder just like you, judging by her height and how labored her movements are. "Captain <last>!" says James. "Glad you could join us. Mayumi is a visiting representative of one of <origin>'s largest mining companies, and she's looking for a captain to help move <cargo> to <destination> for processing. Are you willing to help out? They'll pay for the work, of course."
units.italian: Ogni passo su <origin> è una fatica. Quando raggiungi il caffè dello spazioporto hai appena l'energia per crollare su una sedia con le gambe d'acciaio spesse quanto i cuscini. Dopo una pausa trovi James che parla con una donna forestiera proprio come te, a giudicare dall'altezza e da quanto le costino i movimenti. "Capitano <last>!" dice James. "Contento che tu sia qui. Mayumi è una rappresentante in visita di una delle più grandi compagnie minerarie di <origin>, e cerca un capitano che la aiuti a spostare <cargo> su <destination> per la lavorazione. Sei disposto ad aiutare? Pagheranno per il lavoro, naturalmente."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Freighter]|	"If they're paying, then I'm in."|2040|0
units.english: "If they're paying, then I'm in."
units.italian: "Se pagano, ci sto."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Freighter]|	"Sorry, but I think I'm going to head out on my own."|2041|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I think I'm going to head out on my own."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Freighter]|	"Great!" says James. "They'll be loading up your ship shortly."|2043|0
units.english: "Great!" says James. "They'll be loading up your ship shortly."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice James. "Caricheranno la tua nave a breve."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Freighter]|	A deep fog envelops the spaceport city on <origin>. In the distance, you can see the faded lights of distant starships drifting like phantoms. On the streets below, harsh rain whips against the congested traffic, blurring it into a muddy mess of red light.|2069|0
units.english: A deep fog envelops the spaceport city on <origin>. In the distance, you can see the faded lights of distant starships drifting like phantoms. On the streets below, harsh rain whips against the congested traffic, blurring it into a muddy mess of red light.
units.italian: Una nebbia fitta avvolge la città-spazioporto su <origin>. In lontananza vedi le luci sbiadite di navi stellari lontane che vanno alla deriva come fantasmi. Nelle strade sottostanti una pioggia aspra sferza il traffico congestionato, sfumandolo in una poltiglia fangosa di luce rossa.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Freighter]|	As you walk through the spaceport, James sees you from a distance and waves you over. As you approach, you see several people in radiation suits working behind him. "I've found another job for you," he says.|2070|0
units.english: As you walk through the spaceport, James sees you from a distance and waves you over. As you approach, you see several people in radiation suits working behind him. "I've found another job for you," he says.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto, James ti vede da lontano e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti. Mentre ti avvicini, vedi diverse persone in tute anti-radiazioni che lavorano dietro di lui. "Ho trovato un altro lavoro per te," dice.

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Freighter]|	"I hope it isn't related to those workers."|2072|0
units.english: "I hope it isn't related to those workers."
units.italian: "Spero che non abbia a che fare con quegli operai."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Sorry, I think I'll head off on my own now."|2073|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think I'll head off on my own now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che ora andrò per conto mio."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Freighter]|	"As long as you don't do anything stupid," James says, "like open up the cargo yourself, you'll be safe. <cargo> needs to get to <planet> to help with an urgent reactor fuel shortage, and that means it needs to be there no later than <day>. If we take a direct route, there should be no trouble making the delivery on time. What do you say?"|2075|0
units.english: "As long as you don't do anything stupid," James says, "like open up the cargo yourself, you'll be safe. <cargo> needs to get to <planet> to help with an urgent reactor fuel shortage, and that means it needs to be there no later than <day>. If we take a direct route, there should be no trouble making the delivery on time. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Finché non fai qualcosa di stupido," dice James, "come aprire tu il carico, sarai al sicuro. <cargo> deve arrivare su <planet> per aiutare con un'urgente carenza di combustibile per reattori, e questo significa che deve essere là non più tardi del <day>. Se prendiamo una rotta diretta, non dovremmo avere problemi a consegnare in tempo. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Sounds good. Let's do it!"|2077|0
units.english: "Sounds good. Let's do it!"
units.italian: "Mi sembra bene. Facciamolo!"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Freighter]|	"No way am I loading up my shiny new starship with radioactive rocks. Count me out."|2078|0
units.english: "No way am I loading up my shiny new starship with radioactive rocks. Count me out."
units.italian: "Non carico rocce radioattive sulla mia nave stellare nuova di zecca. Senza di me."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [2 Freighter]|	"Great!" he says. "I mentioned this earlier, but you might want to stop by the outfitter and buy a local map. Hyperspace routes aren't always logical, and the last thing you want to do is get lost and end up with a pile of nuclear fuel no one wants filling up your cargo hold."|2080|0
units.english: "Great!" he says. "I mentioned this earlier, but you might want to stop by the outfitter and buy a local map. Hyperspace routes aren't always logical, and the last thing you want to do is get lost and end up with a pile of nuclear fuel no one wants filling up your cargo hold."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice. "L'ho già detto prima, ma potresti passare dal fornitore e comprare una mappa locale. Le rotte dell'iperspazio non sono sempre logiche, e l'ultima cosa che vuoi è perderti e ritrovarti con un mucchio di combustibile nucleare che nessuno vuole a riempire la stiva."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Interceptor]|Every step on <origin> is a struggle. By the time you reach the spaceport cafe, you have just enough energy to slump into a chair with steel legs as thick as its cushions. After taking a rest, you find James standing on a landing pad underneath a large freighter, chatting with a woman you assume is the captain. "There you are!" he says. "Captain Rawda here says her two ships have always had trouble with pirates in the Core, and she's looking for an escort to get them safely to <planet>. Are you interested?"|2148|0
units.english: Every step on <origin> is a struggle. By the time you reach the spaceport cafe, you have just enough energy to slump into a chair with steel legs as thick as its cushions. After taking a rest, you find James standing on a landing pad underneath a large freighter, chatting with a woman you assume is the captain. "There you are!" he says. "Captain Rawda here says her two ships have always had trouble with pirates in the Core, and she's looking for an escort to get them safely to <planet>. Are you interested?"
units.italian: Ogni passo su <origin> è una fatica. Quando raggiungi il caffè dello spazioporto hai appena l'energia per crollare su una sedia con le gambe d'acciaio spesse quanto i cuscini. Dopo una pausa trovi James in piedi su una piazzola sotto un grande mercantile, che chiacchiera con una donna che supponi sia il capitano. "Eccoti!" dice. "La capitana Rawda qui dice che le sue due navi hanno sempre problemi con i pirati nel Core, e cerca una scorta per portarle sane e salve su <planet>. Ti interessa?"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"Of course!"|2150|0
units.english: "Of course!"
units.italian: "Certamente!"

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"No, sounds a bit too risky for me."|2151|0
units.english: "No, sounds a bit too risky for me."
units.italian: "No, mi sembra troppo rischioso per me."

units.id: mission:Delve Intro [1 Interceptor]|	"Great," he says. "Whenever we're ready to leave the planet, they'll take off behind us and follow us to <planet>." As you begin walking away together, he adds in a quieter voice, "Normally a fresh pilot like you with no combat reputation would never be offered a mission like this, so try not to mess things up. Remember that we don't have to kill the pirates, all we have to do is make sure the convoy isn't destroyed. But freighters are slow, so you can't just go skipping through hyperspace as fast as you want; you need to stick around and make sure they're behind you."|2153|0
units.english: "Great," he says. "Whenever we're ready to leave the planet, they'll take off behind us and follow us to <planet>." As you begin walking away together, he adds in a quieter voice, "Normally a fresh pilot like you with no combat reputation would never be offered a mission like this, so try not to mess things up. Remember that we don't have to kill the pirates, all we have to do is make sure the convoy isn't destroyed. But freighters are slow, so you can't just go skipping through hyperspace as fast as you want; you need to stick around and make sure they're behind you."
units.italian: "Ottimo," dice. "Quando saremo pronti a lasciare il pianeta, decolleranno dietro di noi e ci seguiranno fino a <planet>." Mentre vi allontanate insieme, aggiunge a voce più bassa: "Normalmente a un pilota fresco come te, senza reputazione in combattimento, non verrebbe mai offerta una missione così, quindi cerca di non combinare pasticci. Ricorda che non dobbiamo uccidere i pirati: dobbiamo solo assicurarci che il convoglio non venga distrutto. Ma i mercantili sono lenti, quindi non puoi saltare per l'iperspazio come ti pare e piace: devi restare nei paraggi e assicurarti che siano dietro di te."

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|As you are piloting your ship down to land on <planet>, James disappears into his bunk room. After the ship has landed he comes out, no longer in the grease-stained coveralls he's been wearing up until now, but in a suit.<intro end suit> He smooths down the front of the suit distractedly and then looks at his hands as if unsure of where to put them. "How do I look?" he asks.|2253|0
units.english: As you are piloting your ship down to land on <planet>, James disappears into his bunk room. After the ship has landed he comes out, no longer in the grease-stained coveralls he's been wearing up until now, but in a suit.<intro end suit> He smooths down the front of the suit distractedly and then looks at his hands as if unsure of where to put them. "How do I look?" he asks.
units.italian: Mentre stai pilotando la nave per atterrare su <planet>, James sparisce nella sua cabina. Dopo che la nave si è posata esce, non più con la tuta da lavoro macchiata di grasso che ha indossato fino ad ora, ma in giacca e cravatta.<intro end suit> Si liscia distrattamente il davanti della giacca e poi guarda le proprie mani come se non sapesse dove metterle. "Come sto?" chiede.

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"Like a millionaire."|2255|0
units.english: "Like a millionaire."
units.italian: "Come un milionario."

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"You look great."|2257|0
units.english: "You look great."
units.italian: "Stai benissimo."

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"Well, that's the other thing about being a captain," he says. "You can get filthy rich."|2261|0
units.english: "Well, that's the other thing about being a captain," he says. "You can get filthy rich."
units.italian: "Beh, questo è l'altro lato di fare il capitano," dice. "Puoi diventare sporcamente ricco."

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"Let's hope the locals think so," he says.|2265|0
units.english: "Let's hope the locals think so," he says.
units.italian: "Speriamo che i locali la pensino così," dice.

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	There's an awkward pause. You're unsure of how to respond. Then he says, "Thing is, this here planet is one of the most exclusive retirement communities in the galaxy. Plenty of the locals are probably worth more than a billion credits. But they're mostly financial or business types, or old money. I'm rich enough to be here, but I just hope they're willing to socialize with someone who made his fortune flying a ship.|2268|0
units.english: There's an awkward pause. You're unsure of how to respond. Then he says, "Thing is, this here planet is one of the most exclusive retirement communities in the galaxy. Plenty of the locals are probably worth more than a billion credits. But they're mostly financial or business types, or old money. I'm rich enough to be here, but I just hope they're willing to socialize with someone who made his fortune flying a ship.
units.italian: Segue una pausa imbarazzante. Non sei sicuro di come rispondere. Poi dice: "Il fatto è che questo pianeta è una delle comunità di pensionati più esclusive della galassia. Molti dei locali valgono probabilmente più di un miliardo di crediti. Ma sono per lo più tipi della finanza o degli affari, o soldi di vecchia data. Sono abbastanza ricco da stare qui, spero solo che abbiano voglia di socializzare con qualcuno che ha fatto fortuna pilotando una nave.

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"Before you go, is there anything else you'd like to ask me about being a new pilot?"|2269|0
units.english: "Before you go, is there anything else you'd like to ask me about being a new pilot?"
units.italian: "Prima che tu vada, c'è altro che vuoi chiedermi su come essere un pilota nuovo?"

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"Where should I go if I want to avoid pirates?"|2272|0
units.english: "Where should I go if I want to avoid pirates?"
units.italian: "Dove dovrei andare se voglio evitare i pirati?"

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"Have you ever met any aliens?"|2275|0
units.english: "Have you ever met any aliens?"
units.italian: "Hai mai incontrato qualche alieno?"

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"Are there any good trade routes you can give me?"|2279|0
units.english: "Are there any good trade routes you can give me?"
units.italian: "Ci sono buone rotte commerciali che puoi consigliarmi?"

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"Where can I find well-paying jobs?"|2283|0
units.english: "Where can I find well-paying jobs?"
units.italian: "Dove posso trovare lavori ben pagati?"

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"I'm ready to go out on my own."|2287|0
units.english: "I'm ready to go out on my own."
units.italian: "Sono pronto ad andare per conto mio."

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"Stay near Sol and around the Paradise Worlds. The Navy stays there the most, so even if a pirate does show up, they won't last long. The Deep is also a pretty safe place, as they have their own security forces. Once you start moving farther south, things get riskier. The worlds down there don't bring in as much tax revenue as the Paradise Worlds do, so the Navy tends to ignore them. You'll find some local militia to back you up, but they're nothing compared to one of the Navy's Cruisers.|2291|0
units.english: "Stay near Sol and around the Paradise Worlds. The Navy stays there the most, so even if a pirate does show up, they won't last long. The Deep is also a pretty safe place, as they have their own security forces. Once you start moving farther south, things get riskier. The worlds down there don't bring in as much tax revenue as the Paradise Worlds do, so the Navy tends to ignore them. You'll find some local militia to back you up, but they're nothing compared to one of the Navy's Cruisers.
units.italian: "Resta vicino a Sol e intorno ai Mondi Paradisiaci. È lì che la Marina staziona di più, quindi anche se spunta un pirata non dura a lungo. Anche il Deep è un posto piuttosto sicuro, hanno forze di sicurezza proprie. Quando cominci a spostarti più a sud, le cose si fanno rischiose. I mondi laggiù non portano tanto gettito fiscale quanto i Mondi Paradisiaci, quindi la Marina tende a ignorarli. Troverai qualche milizia locale a coprirti, ma non è niente in confronto a uno degli incrociatori della Marina.

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"If you do end up in pirate space, then sometimes the best defense is no defense at all. Pirates will prioritize fighting armed threats over unarmed transports, so if you don't install any weapons, you might be able to sneak away."|2292|0
units.english: "If you do end up in pirate space, then sometimes the best defense is no defense at all. Pirates will prioritize fighting armed threats over unarmed transports, so if you don't install any weapons, you might be able to sneak away."
units.italian: "Se finisci davvero nello spazio dei pirati, a volte la migliore difesa è non avere difese. I pirati daranno priorità a combattere le minacce armate rispetto ai trasporti disarmati, quindi se non installi armi potresti riuscire a sgattaiolare via."

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"I've spoken with the Quarg a few times, but what captain hasn't? You'll find them down south by Tarazed. I haven't met any other aliens," he pauses for a moment, "as far as I'm aware, that is, but I'm sure they're out there if you go looking hard enough. I've explored all of Republic space in my many years, but there are far more systems out there that we don't even know how to reach."|2298|0
units.english: "I've spoken with the Quarg a few times, but what captain hasn't? You'll find them down south by Tarazed. I haven't met any other aliens," he pauses for a moment, "as far as I'm aware, that is, but I'm sure they're out there if you go looking hard enough. I've explored all of Republic space in my many years, but there are far more systems out there that we don't even know how to reach."
units.italian: "Ho parlato con i Quarg un paio di volte, ma quale capitano non l'ha fatto? Li troverai a sud, vicino a Tarazed. Non ho incontrato altri alieni," si ferma un momento, "almeno per quanto ne sappia, ma sono sicuro che ci siano, se cerchi abbastanza a fondo. Ho esplorato tutto lo spazio della Repubblica nei miei molti anni, ma là fuori ci sono molti più sistemi che non sappiamo nemmeno come raggiungere."

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"One of the most reliable trade routes is to bring food from the Dirt Belt to Earth or the other urban worlds around it. There are billions of mouths to feed on those worlds, and the Dirt Belt sells food for cheap, so it's a great place to get started. Just remember though that if you use the same trade route for too long, you might end up causing the prices to stabilize. The Dirt Belt can only produce food and people can only eat it so fast, so change up your trade routes if you notice the return getting worse."|2304|0
units.english: "One of the most reliable trade routes is to bring food from the Dirt Belt to Earth or the other urban worlds around it. There are billions of mouths to feed on those worlds, and the Dirt Belt sells food for cheap, so it's a great place to get started. Just remember though that if you use the same trade route for too long, you might end up causing the prices to stabilize. The Dirt Belt can only produce food and people can only eat it so fast, so change up your trade routes if you notice the return getting worse."
units.italian: "Una delle rotte commerciali più affidabili è portare cibo dalla Dirt Belt alla Terra o agli altri mondi urbani intorno. Su quei mondi ci sono miliardi di bocche da sfamare, e la Dirt Belt vende cibo a buon mercato, quindi è un ottimo posto per cominciare. Ricorda però che se usi la stessa rotta troppo a lungo, potresti finire per stabilizzarne i prezzi. La Dirt Belt può produrre cibo solo fino a un certo punto e la gente può mangiarlo solo così in fretta, quindi cambia rotte se noti che il guadagno peggiora."

units.id: conversation:end of intro missions|	"Getting good jobs is more about having the space to accept the good jobs than it is finding them, but if you're looking for jobs that pay well for little effort, then you'll want to watch out around the holidays. There's always a big celebration on Earth every April 22nd, Earth Day, so pay attention to the job board in the months leading up to that. The people down in the Rim have some month-long celebration every August that you should look out for too."|2310|0
units.english: "Getting good jobs is more about having the space to accept the good jobs than it is finding them, but if you're looking for jobs that pay well for little effort, then you'll want to watch out around the holidays.
